meaning: ຂັ້ນຕອນວິທີ
example: The search engine uses a smart algorithm.
example_lao: ເຄື່ອງຈັກຊອກຫາໃຊ້ຂັ້ນຕອນວິທີທີ່ສະຫຼາດ.

meaning: ແອັບພລິເຄຊັນ
example: I downloaded a new language application.
example_lao: ຂ້ອຍດາວໂຫຼດແອັບພລິເຄຊັນຮຽນພາສາໃໝ່.

meaning: ປັນຍາປະດິດ
example: Artificial Intelligence is transforming education.
example_lao: ປັນຍາປະດິດກຳລັງປ່ຽນແປງວົງການການສຶກສາ.

meaning: ສຳຮອງຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Always backup your important files to the cloud.
example_lao: ສຳຮອງຂໍ້ມູນໄຟລ໌ສຳຄັນຂອງທ່ານໄວ້ໃນ Cloud ສະເໝີ.

meaning: ແບນວິດ / ຄວາມໄວເຄືອຂ່າຍ
example: Video streaming requires high bandwidth.
example_lao: ການເບິ່ງວິດີໂອອອນລາຍຕ້ອງການຄວາມໄວເຄືອຂ່າຍສູງ.

meaning: ເວັບບຣາວເຊີ
example: You should update your web browser regularly.
example_lao: ທ່ານຄວນອັບເດດເວັບບຣາວເຊີຂອງທ່ານເປັນປະຈຳ.

meaning: ລະບົບຄລາວ
example: All photos are stored safely in the cloud.
example_lao: ຮູບພາບທັງໝົດຖືກເກັບຮັກສາໄວ້ຢ່າງປອດໄພໃນລະບົບຄລາວ.

meaning: ຄວາມປອດໄພທາງໄຊເບີ
example: Cybersecurity is essential for modern companies.
example_lao: ຄວາມປອດໄພທາງໄຊເບີແມ່ນສິ່ງຈຳເປັນສຳລັບບໍລິສັດຍຸກໃໝ່.

meaning: ຖານຂໍ້ມູນ
example: The customer database was updated today.
example_lao: ຖານຂໍ້ມູນລູກຄ້າຖືກອັບເດດແລ້ວໃນມື້ນີ້.

meaning: ດາວໂຫຼດ
example: It takes two minutes to download the file.
example_lao: ມັນໃຊ້ເວລາສອງນາທີເພື່ອດາວໂຫຼດໄຟລ໌.

meaning: ການເຂົ້າລະຫັດຂໍ້ມູນ
example: This chat app uses end-to-end encryption.
example_lao: ແອັບແຊັດນີ້ໃຊ້ການເຂົ້າລະຫັດຂໍ້ມູນແບບຕົ້ນທາງຮອດປາຍທາງ.

meaning: ລະບົບໄຟວໍປ້ອງກັນ
example: The firewall blocked the suspicious connection.
example_lao: ລະບົບໄຟວໍໄດ້ສະກັດກັ້ນການເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ທີ່ໜ້າສົງໄສ.

meaning: ຮາດແວ / ອຸປະກອນຄອມພິວເຕີ
example: We need to upgrade our server hardware.
example_lao: ພວກເຮົາຕ້ອງອັບເກຣດອຸປະກອນຮາດແວຂອງເຊີບເວີ.

meaning: ໜ້າຕາລະບົບ / ອິນເຕີເຟສ
example: The user interface is simple and clean.
example_lao: ໜ້າຕາການໃຊ້ງານຂອງລະບົບແມ່ນງ່າຍດາຍ ແລະ ສະອາດ.

meaning: ແປ້ນພິມ
example: I bought a mechanical wireless keyboard.
example_lao: ຂ້ອຍໄດ້ຊື້ແປ້ນພິມໄຮ້ສາຍແບບກົນໄກ.

meaning: ຄອມພິວເຕີໂນ໊ດບຸກ
example: Her laptop battery lasts for ten hours.
example_lao: ແບັດເຕີຣີໂນ໊ດບຸກຂອງນາງໃຊ້ໄດ້ດົນເຖິງສິບຊົ່ວໂມງ.

meaning: ມັນແວ / ໂປຣແກຣມອັນຕະລາຍ
example: Antivirus software protects against malware.
example_lao: ໂປຣແກຣມແອນຕີ້ໄວຣັສຊ່ວຍປ້ອງກັນມັນແວ.

meaning: ເຄືອຂ່າຍ
example: The office local network is fast and stable.
example_lao: ເຄືອຂ່າຍພາຍໃນຫ້ອງການໄວ ແລະ ສະຖຽນດີ.

meaning: ລະຫັດຜ່ານ
example: Create a strong password with letters and numbers.
example_lao: ສ້າງລະຫັດຜ່ານທີ່ປອດໄພດ້ວຍໂຕອັກສອນ ແລະ ໂຕເລກ.

meaning: ຄວາມເປັນສ່ວນຕົວ
example: Check your privacy settings on social media.
example_lao: ກວດເບິ່ງການຕັ້ງຄ່າຄວາມເປັນສ່ວນຕົວຂອງທ່ານໃນໂຊຊຽວ.

meaning: ໜ່ວຍປະມວນຜົນ
example: A faster processor speeds up video editing.
example_lao: ໜ່ວຍປະມວນຜົນທີ່ໄວກວ່າຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ການຕັດຕໍ່ວິດີໂອໄວຂຶ້ນ.

meaning: ການຂຽນໂປຣແກຣມ
example: Learning programming opens many career paths.
example_lao: ການຮຽນຂຽນໂປຣແກຣມເປີດໂອກາດສາຍອາຊີບຫຼາຍຢ່າງ.

meaning: ຣາວເຕີ / ອຸປະກອນກະຈາຍສັນຍານ
example: Restart the Wi-Fi router if connection drops.
example_lao: ຣີສະຕາດຣາວເຕີ Wi-Fi ຖ້າສັນຍານຫຼຸດ.

meaning: ເຊີບເວີ
example: The website server is running smoothly.
example_lao: ເຊີບເວີຂອງເວັບໄຊກຳລັງເຮັດວຽກໄດ້ຢ່າງຮາບຮື່ນ.

meaning: ຊອບແວ / ໂປຣແກຣມ
example: Please install the latest software updates.
example_lao: ກະລຸນາຕິດຕັ້ງຊອບແວອັບເດດລ່າສຸດ.

meaning: ພື້ນທີ່ເກັບຂໍ້ມູນ
example: My phone storage is almost full.
example_lao: ພື້ນທີ່ເກັບຂໍ້ມູນໃນໂທລະສັບຂອງຂ້ອຍເກືອບເຕັມແລ້ວ.

meaning: ການສະຕຣີມມິ່ງ / ເບິ່ງອອນລາຍ
example: Music streaming is very popular today.
example_lao: ການຟັງເພງແບບສະຕຣີມມິ່ງແມ່ນໄດ້ຮັບຄວາມນິຍົມຫຼາຍໃນປະຈຸບັນ.

meaning: ອັບເດດ / ປັບປຸງໃໝ່
example: The system will update automatically tonight.
example_lao: ລະບົບຈະອັບເດດໂດຍອັດຕະໂນມັດໃນຄືນນີ້.

meaning: ອັບໂຫຼດ
example: She uploaded her new video to YouTube.
example_lao: ນາງໄດ້ອັບໂຫຼດວິດີໂອໃໝ່ຂອງນາງລົງ YouTube.

meaning: ໄຮ້ສາຍ
example: Wireless chargers make life easier.
example_lao: ສາຍສາກໄຮ້ສາຍເຮັດໃຫ້ຊີວິດສະດວກສະບາຍຂຶ້ນ.

meaning: ໜ່ວຍປະມວນຜົນກາງ
example: The CPU is the central brain of any computer system.
example_lao: CPU ແມ່ນສະໝອງຫຼັກຂອງລະບົບຄອມພິວເຕີ.

meaning: ກາດຈໍ / ໜ່ວຍປະມວນຜົນກຣາບຟິກ
example: Modern gaming and AI training require a powerful GPU.
example_lao: ການຫຼິ້ນເກມ ແລະ ຝຶກສອນ AI ຕ້ອງການ GPU ທີ່ມີປະສິດທິພາບສູງ.

meaning: ໜ່ວຍຄວາມຈຳຫຼັກ
example: Adding more RAM allows smoother multitasking.
example_lao: ການເພີ່ມ RAM ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ເປີດຫຼາຍໂປຣແກຣມພ້ອມກັນໄດ້ລຽບນຽນຂຶ້ນ.

meaning: ເມນບອດ / ແຜງວົງຈອນຫຼັກ
example: All components are plugged directly into the motherboard.
example_lao: ອຸປະກອນທຸກຢ່າງຖືກສຽບເຂົ້າໃສ່ເມນບອດໂດຍກົງ.

meaning: ຮາດດິດແບບໂຊລິດສະເຕດ
example: An SSD boots operating systems in just seconds.
example_lao: SSD ຊ່ວຍເປີດລະບົບປະຕິບັດການໄດ້ພາຍໃນບໍ່ເທົ່າໃດວິນາທີ.

meaning: ຮາດດິດຈານໝູນ
example: HDDs provide high capacity storage at lower cost.
example_lao: HDD ໃຫ້ພື້ນທີ່ເກັບຂໍ້ມູນສູງໃນລາຄາທີ່ປະຢັດກວ່າ.

meaning: ເທັກໂນໂລຊີ ສົ່ງຂໍ້ມູນຄວາມໄວສູງ
example: NVMe drives deliver lightning fast read and write speeds.
example_lao: ໄດຣຟ໌ NVMe ໃຫ້ຄວາມໄວໃນການອ່ານ ແລະ ຂຽນຂໍ້ມູນຢ່າງໄວວາ.

meaning: ໝໍ້ແປງໄຟຄອມພິວເຕີ
example: A 750W power supply delivers steady electricity.
example_lao: ໝໍ້ແປງໄຟ 750W ຈ່າຍກະແສໄຟຟ້າໄດ້ຢ່າງສະໝ່ຳສະເໝີ.

meaning: ພັດລົມ / ລະບົບລະບາຍຄວາມຮ້ອນ
example: Liquid coolers keep the CPU cool under heavy loads.
example_lao: ລະບົບນ້ຳລະບາຍຄວາມຮ້ອນຊ່ວຍຮັກສາອຸນຫະພູມ CPU ໃຫ້ເຢັນ.

meaning: ແຜ່ນລະບາຍຄວາມຮ້ອນ
example: The aluminum heatsink dissipates excess heat efficiently.
example_lao: ແຜ່ນລະບາຍຄວາມຮ້ອນອາລູມິນຽມຊ່ວຍກະຈາຍຄວາມຮ້ອນໄດ້ດີ.

meaning: ຊິລິໂຄນລະບາຍຄວາມຮ້ອນ
example: Apply thermal paste between the CPU and cooler.
example_lao: ທາຊິລິໂຄນລະບາຍຄວາມຮ້ອນລະຫວ່າງ CPU ແລະ ຊຸດລະບາຍຄວາມຮ້ອນ.

meaning: ການໂອເວີຄລັອກ / ເລັ່ງຄວາມໄວຮາດແວ
example: Overclocking increases processor performance but generates heat.
example_lao: ການໂອເວີຄລັອກເພີ່ມຄວາມໄວໃຫ້ໜ່ວຍປະມວນຜົນ ແຕ່ຈະເກີດຄວາມຮ້ອນ.

meaning: ເຄສຄອມພິວເຕີ / ໂຄງເຄສ
example: The computer chassis has excellent airflow design.
example_lao: ເຄສຄອມພິວເຕີມີການອອກແບບລະບົບໄຫຼວຽນອາກາດທີ່ດີເລີດ.

meaning: ຈໍສະແດງຜົນ
example: He bought a 4K 144Hz gaming monitor.
example_lao: ລາວໄດ້ຊື້ຈໍມໍນິເຕີສຳລັບຫຼິ້ນເກມແບບ 4K 144Hz.

meaning: ອຸປະກອນເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ພາຍນອກ
example: Keyboards and mice are standard computer peripherals.
example_lao: ແປ້ນພິມ ແລະ ເມົາສ໌ ແມ່ນອຸປະກອນເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ພາຍນອກມາດຕະຖານ.

meaning: ໄມໂຄຣຊິບ
example: Microchips power billions of smart devices worldwide.
example_lao: ໄມໂຄຣຊິບຂັບເຄື່ອນອຸປະກອນອັດສະລິຍະຫຼາຍພັນລ້ານເຄື່ອງທົ່ວໂລກ.

meaning: ສານເຄິ່ງຕົວນຳ
example: Global semiconductor supply chains are strategically vital.
example_lao: ຕ່ອງໂສ້ການຜະລິດສານເຄິ່ງຕົວນຳທົ່ວໂລກມີຄວາມສຳຄັນທາງຍຸດທະສາດ.

meaning: ທຣານຊິສເຕີ
example: Modern microprocessors contain billions of nanometer transistors.
example_lao: ໂປຣເຊສເຊີຍຸກໃໝ່ບັນຈຸທຣານຊິສເຕີຂະໜາດນາໂນແມັດຫຼາຍພັນລ້ານໂຕ.

meaning: ພອດເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ຈໍ
example: Use DisplayPort for highest refresh rates on PC.
example_lao: ໃຊ້ DisplayPort ເພື່ອອັດຕາຣີເຟຣຊສູງສຸດເທິງ PC.

meaning: ສາຍເຊື່ອມຕໍ່
example: Connect the laptop to the TV using an HDMI cable.
example_lao: ເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ໂນ໊ດບຸກກັບໂທລະພາບໂດຍໃຊ້ສາຍ HDMI.

meaning: ພອດ - ຮຸ່ນໃໝ່
example: USB-C supports fast charging and superfast data transfer.
example_lao: USB-C ຮອງຮັບການສາກໄວ ແລະ ການໂອນຖ່າຍຂໍ້ມູນຄວາມໄວສູງ.

meaning: ພອດ ຄວາມໄວສູງ
example: Thunderbolt 4 allows connecting multiple 4K displays.
example_lao: Thunderbolt 4 ສາມາດເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ຈໍ 4K ໄດ້ຫຼາຍຈໍພ້ອມກັນ.

meaning: ບລູທູດ
example: Pair your wireless earbuds via Bluetooth.
example_lao: ເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ຫູຟັງໄຮ້ສາຍຂອງທ່ານຜ່ານບລູທູດ.

meaning: ໄມໂຄຣຄອນໂທຣລເລີ
example: The microcontroller automates the home irrigation system.
example_lao: ໄມໂຄຣຄອນໂທຣລເລີຄວບຄຸມລະບົບຫົດນ້ຳອັດຕະໂນມັດໃນບ້ານ.

meaning: ຄອມພິວເຕີບອດດ່ຽວ
example: We built a home media server using a Raspberry Pi.
example_lao: ພວກເຮົາໄດ້ສ້າງເຊີບເວີມີເດຍໃນບ້ານໂດຍໃຊ້ Raspberry Pi.

meaning: ບອດທົດລອງໄມໂຄຣຄອນໂທຣລເລີ
example: Students use Arduino to build robotics projects.
example_lao: ນັກຮຽນໃຊ້ Arduino ເພື່ອສ້າງໂຄງງານຫຸ່ນຍົນ.

meaning: ເຊັນເຊີ / ຕົວວັດແທກ
example: The motion sensor turns on lights automatically.
example_lao: ເຊັນເຊີກວດຈັບການເຄື່ອນໄຫວເປີດໄຟໂດຍອັດຕະໂນມັດ.

meaning: ຕົວກະຕຸ້ນກົນໄກ
example: Actuators convert electrical signals into mechanical motion.
example_lao: Actuator ປ່ຽນສັນຍານໄຟຟ້າເປັນການເຄື່ອນໄຫວທາງກົນຈັກ.

meaning: ລະບົບໄບອັອສ
example: Access the BIOS menu to change the boot sequence.
example_lao: ເຂົ້າເມນູ BIOS ເພື່ອປ່ຽນລຳດັບການບູດເຄື່ອງ.

meaning: ເຟີມແວ
example: Update the router firmware to fix security vulnerabilities.
example_lao: ອັບເດດເຟີມແວຣາວເຕີເພື່ອແກ້ໄຂຊ່ອງໂຫວ່ຄວາມປອດໄພ.

meaning: ພາສາໂຄງສ້າງເວັບໄຊ
example: HTML forms the structural skeleton of all web pages.
example_lao: HTML ເປັນໂຄງສ້າງຫຼັກຂອງໜ້າເວັບໄຊທັງໝົດ.

meaning: ພາສາຕົກແຕ່ງໜ້າເວັບ
example: CSS controls typography, layout, and visual themes.
example_lao: CSS ຄວບຄຸມຕົວອັກສອນ, ການຈັດວາງ ແລະ ຮູບແບບສີສັນ.

meaning: ພາສາຈາວາສະຄຣິບ
example: JavaScript adds dynamic interactivity to modern websites.
example_lao: JavaScript ເພີ່ມການໂຕ້ຕອບແບບເຄື່ອນໄຫວໃຫ້ເວັບໄຊ.

meaning: ພາສາໄທສ໌ສະຄຣິບ
example: TypeScript provides type safety and catches runtime bugs.
example_lao: TypeScript ຊ່ວຍກວດສອບ Type ແລະ ປ້ອງກັນ Bug ຕັ້ງແຕ່ຕອນຂຽນໂຄ້ດ.

meaning: ໄລບຣາຣີ ສຳລັບ
example: React builds modular reusable user interface components.
example_lao: React ຊ່ວຍສ້າງ Component ໜ້າຕາ UI ທີ່ນຳກັບມາໃຊ້ໃໝ່ໄດ້.

meaning: ໂຄງສ້າງ ຂອງໜ້າເວັບ
example: JavaScript manipulates the DOM to update page elements.
example_lao: JavaScript ຈັດການ DOM ເພື່ອປ່ຽນແປງຂໍ້ມູນເທິງໜ້າເວັບ.

meaning: ຂະບວນການ ເທິງເວັບ
example: Hydration attaches event listeners to server-rendered HTML.
example_lao: Hydration ຜູກມັດ Event Listener ເຂົ້າກັບ HTML ທີ່ Render ມາຈາກເຊີບເວີ.

meaning: ການອອກແບບເວັບຮອງຮັບທຸກໜ້າຈໍ
example: Responsive design ensures great user experience on mobile.
example_lao: ການອອກແບບ Responsive ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ໃຊ້ງານເທິງມືຖືໄດ້ດີ.

meaning: ລະບົບຈັດວາງ
example: Flexbox aligns elements easily along rows and columns.
example_lao: Flexbox ຊ່ວຍຈັດຮຽງອົງປະກອບໃນແຖວ ແລະ ຖັນໄດ້ງ່າຍ.

meaning: ລະບົບຕາຕະລາງ
example: CSS Grid enables complex two-dimensional layout architectures.
example_lao: CSS Grid ຊ່ວຍສ້າງ Layout ສອງມິຕິທີ່ມີຄວາມຊັບຊ້ອນ.

meaning: ເຟຣມເວິກ
example: Tailwind CSS speeds up styling with utility classes.
example_lao: Tailwind CSS ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ແຕ່ງໜ້າເວັບໄດ້ໄວຂຶ້ນ.

meaning: ຄອມໂພເນັ້ນ / ສ່ວນປະກອບ
example: Each button is written as a reusable UI component.
example_lao: ປຸ່ມແຕ່ລະອັນຖືກຂຽນເປັນ Component ທີ່ນຳມາໃຊ້ໃໝ່ໄດ້.

meaning: ສະຖານະຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Component state tracks user input and toggle states.
example_lao: State ຂອງ Component ເກັບກຳຂໍ້ມູນການປ້ອນ ແລະ ສະຖານະຕ່າງໆ.

meaning: ຄ່າ ສົ່ງຕໍ່ຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Pass data to child components using props.
example_lao: ສົ່ງຕໍ່ຂໍ້ມູນໄປຍັງ Component ລູກໂດຍໃຊ້ Props.

meaning: ຮຸກ ໃນ
example: The useState hook manages reactive local component state.
example_lao: useState hook ຊ່ວຍຈັດການ State ພາຍໃນ Component.

meaning: ໄຟລ໌ລວມໂຄ້ດ
example: Webpack creates an optimized JavaScript production bundle.
example_lao: Webpack ສ້າງ Bundle ໂຄ້ດ JavaScript ທີ່ຖືກບີບອັດໃຫ້ມີປະສິດທິພາບ.

meaning: ການບີບອັດຂະໜາດໂຄ້ດ
example: Minification removes whitespaces to reduce JavaScript file size.
example_lao: Minification ລຶບຍະຫວ່າງເພື່ອຫຼຸດຂະໜາດໄຟລ໌ໂຄ້ດ.

meaning: ເວັບໄຊໜ້າດຽວ
example: Single page applications load pages smoothly without refreshing.
example_lao: SPA ໂຫຼດໜ້າເວັບຢ່າງລຽບນຽນໂດຍບໍ່ຕ້ອງຣີເຟຣຊໜ້າຈໍ.

meaning: ແອັບເວັບກ້າວໜ້າ
example: A progressive web app can be installed like native apps.
example_lao: PWA ສາມາດຕິດຕັ້ງລົງມືຖືໄດ້ຄືກັບແອັບທົ່ວໄປ.

meaning: ເຊີວິດເວີກເກີ
example: Service workers enable offline caching and push notifications.
example_lao: Service Worker ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ໃຊ້ງານ Offline ແລະ ແຈ້ງເຕືອນ Push ໄດ້.

meaning: ເວັບແອສເຊັມບລີ
example: WebAssembly runs near-native code directly inside web browsers.
example_lao: WebAssembly ແລ່ນໂຄ້ດຄວາມໄວສູງລະດັບ Native ໄດ້ເທິງບຣາວເຊີ.

meaning: ການສື່ສານສົດຜ່ານເວັບ
example: WebRTC enables real-time peer-to-peer video calls.
example_lao: WebRTC ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ໂທວິດີໂອຄໍຜ່ານເວັບໄດ້ແບບ Real-time.

meaning: ເວັບຊັອກເກັດ
example: WebSocket provides full-duplex persistent two-way communication.
example_lao: WebSocket ໃຫ້ການເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ສື່ສານສອງທາງແບບຕໍ່ເນື່ອງ.

meaning: ຄຸກກີ້
example: Authentication cookies keep you logged into your account.
example_lao: Cookie ຊ່ວຍຈື່ສະຖານະການເຂົ້າສູ່ລະບົບຂອງທ່ານ.

meaning: ພື້ນທີ່ເກັບຂໍ້ມູນທ້ອງຖິ່ນໃນບຣາວເຊີ
example: LocalStorage preserves user theme preferences across sessions.
example_lao: LocalStorage ເກັບການຕັ້ງຄ່າ Theme ຂອງຜູ້ໃຊ້ໄວ້.

meaning: ເຊດຊັນ
example: The session expires automatically after thirty minutes of inactivity.
example_lao: Session ຈະໝົດອາຍຸອັດຕະໂນມັດເມື່ອບໍ່ມີການເຄື່ອນໄຫວ 30 ນາທີ.

meaning: ການປັບແຕ່ງຕິດອັນດັບ
example: Good SEO boosts your organic search rankings significantly.
example_lao: SEO ທີ່ດີຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ເວັບໄຊຕິດອັນດັບການຄົ້ນຫາ Google ໄດ້ສູງຂຶ້ນ.

meaning: ໄອຄອນໜ້າເວັບ
example: The favicon displays next to the page title on tabs.
example_lao: Favicon ສະແດງຂ້າງຫົວຂໍ້ໜ້າເວັບເທິງແຖບ Tab.

meaning: ລະບົບຫຼັງບ້ານ
example: The backend handles database queries and business logic.
example_lao: ລະບົບ Backend ຈັດການຖານຂໍ້ມູນ ແລະ ເຫດຜົນທາງທຸລະກິດ.

meaning: ຊ່ອງທາງເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ໂປຣແກຣມ
example: The mobile app communicates with server via REST API.
example_lao: ແອັບມືຖືສື່ສານກັບເຊີບເວີຜ່ານ REST API.

meaning: ຈຸດເຊື່ອມຕໍ່
example: The payment endpoint processes credit card transactions securely.
example_lao: Endpoint ຊຳລະເງິນປະມວນຜົນທຸລະກຳບັດເຄຣດິດຢ່າງປອດໄພ.

meaning: ຂໍ້ມູນທີ່ສົ່ງໃນ
example: The JSON payload contains user profile information.
example_lao: Payload ແບບ JSON ບັນຈຸຂໍ້ມູນໂປຣໄຟລ໌ຂອງຜູ້ໃຊ້.

meaning: ສະຖາປັດຕະຍະກຳ
example: RESTful APIs use standard HTTP GET, POST, PUT, DELETE methods.
example_lao: REST API ໃຊ້ມາດຕະຖານ HTTP ເຊັ່ນ GET, POST, PUT, DELETE.

meaning: ພາສາສອບຖາມຂໍ້ມູນ
example: GraphQL lets clients request exactly the data fields they need.
example_lao: GraphQL ໃຫ້ Client ເລືອກດຶງສະເພາະຟິວຂໍ້ມູນທີ່ຕ້ອງການໄດ້.

meaning: ເວັບຮຸກ
example: Stripe sends a webhook notification when payment succeeds.
example_lao: Stripe ສົ່ງ Webhook ແຈ້ງເຕືອນເມື່ອການຊຳລະເງິນສຳເລັດ.

meaning: ມິດເດິນແວ
example: Authentication middleware verifies JWT tokens on incoming requests.
example_lao: Middleware ກວດສອບ JWT Token ຂອງທຸກໆ Request ທີ່ເຂົ້າມາ.

meaning: ສະຖາປັດຕະຍະກຳ
example: Microservices break a large system into smaller decoupled services.
example_lao: Microservices ແບ່ງລະບົບໃຫຍ່ອອກເປັນບໍລິການຍ່ອຍທີ່ເປັນອິດສະຫຼະ.

meaning: ລະບົບແບບໂມໂນລິທ
example: A monolithic application houses all codebase in one project.
example_lao: Monolith ແມ່ນລະບົບທີ່ລວມທຸກໂຄ້ດໄວ້ໃນໂປຣເຈັກດຽວ.

meaning: ເຟຣມເວິກ .
example: Express is a fast minimalist web framework for Node.js.
example_lao: Express ແມ່ນເຟຣມເວິກທີ່ວ່ອງໄວ ແລະ ງ່າຍດາຍສຳລັບ Node.js.

meaning: ພາສາໄພທອນ
example: Python is the primary language for machine learning and AI.
example_lao: Python ເປັນພາສາຫຼັກສຳລັບ Machine Learning ແລະ AI.

meaning: ເຟຣມເວິກ
example: Django comes with built-in authentication and admin panel.
example_lao: Django ມາພ້ອມລະບົບສະມາຊິກ ແລະ ໜ້າຈັດການ Admin ໃນຕົວ.

meaning: ເຟຣມເວິກ
example: FastAPI builds high-performance Python APIs with automatic docs.
example_lao: FastAPI ສ້າງ API ດ້ວຍ Python ທີ່ມີຄວາມໄວສູງພ້ອມ Docs ອັດຕະໂນມັດ.

meaning: ການກຳນົດເສັ້ນທາງ
example: Server routing directs URL paths to their corresponding handlers.
example_lao: Routing ນຳທາງ URL ໄປຍັງ Handler ທີ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງ.

meaning: ການຈຳກັດຄວາມຖີ່
example: Rate limiting prevents brute force attacks on the login route.
example_lao: Rate limiting ປ້ອງກັນການຍິງ Request ຖີ່ເກີນໄປ.

meaning: ຄຸນສົມບັດ ຂອງ
example: PUT requests are idempotent because repeated calls yield same result.
example_lao: PUT Request ມີຄຸນສົມບັດ Idempotent ເພາະເອີ້ນຊ້ຳໆກໍໄດ້ຜົນຄືເກົ່າ.

meaning: ລະຫັດສະຖານະ
example: Status code 200 means success, while 404 indicates not found.
example_lao: Status Code 200 ແປວ່າສຳເລັດ ສ່ວນ 404 ແປວ່າບໍ່ພົບໜ້າ.

meaning: ນະໂຍບາຍ ຂ້າມໂດເມນ
example: Configure CORS headers to allow cross-origin frontend requests.
example_lao: ຕັ້ງຄ່າ CORS ເພື່ອອະນຸຍາດໃຫ້ Frontend ຕ່າງ Domain ເອີ້ນໃຊ້ API ໄດ້.

meaning: ໂທເຄັນ
example: JWT tokens carry encoded user identity securely.
example_lao: JWT Token ເກັບຂໍ້ມູນຢືນຢັນຕົວຕົນຂອງຜູ້ໃຊ້ຢ່າງປອດໄພ.

meaning: ມາດຕະຖານ
example: OAuth lets users sign in with Google or GitHub safely.
example_lao: OAuth ໃຫ້ຜູ້ໃຊ້ເຂົ້າສູ່ລະບົບຜ່ານ Google ຫຼື GitHub ໄດ້ຢ່າງປອດໄພ.

meaning: ຊຸດພັດທະນາຊອບແວ
example: Install the mobile SDK to integrate push notifications.
example_lao: ຕິດຕັ້ງ SDK ເພື່ອເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ລະບົບແຈ້ງເຕືອນ Push Notification.

meaning: ຄິວສົ່ງຂໍ້ຄວາມ
example: Message queues handle background email delivery asynchronously.
example_lao: Message Queue ຊ່ວຍສົ່ງອີເມວຢູ່ເບື້ອງຫຼັງແບບ Asynchronous.

meaning: ລະບົບ
example: Apache Kafka streams millions of real-time events per second.
example_lao: Apache Kafka ສົ່ງຖ່າຍ Event ຫຼາຍລ້ານລາຍການຕໍ່ວິນາທີ.

meaning: ລະບົບ
example: RabbitMQ routes background tasks to worker processes.
example_lao: RabbitMQ ແຈກຢາຍວຽກ Background ໄປຍັງ Worker.

meaning: ວຽກອັດຕະໂນມັດຕາມເວລາ
example: A nightly cron job generates sales report automatically.
example_lao: Cron Job ເຮັດວຽກຕອນກາງຄືນເພື່ອສ້າງລາຍງານການຂາຍອັດຕະໂນມັດ.

meaning: ໂປຣເຊສເຮັດວຽກເບື້ອງຫຼັງ
example: Background workers convert uploaded videos into multiple resolutions.
example_lao: Worker ຢູ່ເບື້ອງຫຼັງແປງໄຟລ໌ວິດີໂອເປັນຫຼາຍຄວາມລະອຽດ.

meaning: ສະຖາປັດຕະຍະກຳ
example: Serverless functions scale to zero when there is no traffic.
example_lao: Serverless ຈະຫຼຸດການໃຊ້ງານເປັນສູນເມື່ອບໍ່ມີຄົນເຂົ້າຊົມ.

meaning: ບໍລິການ
example: AWS Lambda executes code only when triggered by events.
example_lao: AWS Lambda ຈະແລ່ນໂຄ້ດສະເພາະຕອນມີ Event ມາກະຕຸ້ນ.

meaning: ຖານຂໍ້ມູນ
example: PostgreSQL is a powerful open-source relational database system.
example_lao: PostgreSQL ແມ່ນລະບົບຖານຂໍ້ມູນ Relational ແບບ Open-source ທີ່ຊົງພະລັງ.

meaning: ຖານຂໍ້ມູນ
example: MySQL powers millions of dynamic websites and e-commerce platforms.
example_lao: MySQL ຂັບເຄື່ອນເວັບໄຊ ແລະ ຮ້ານຄ້າອອນລາຍຫຼາຍລ້ານແຫ່ງ.

meaning: ຖານຂໍ້ມູນ ແບບ
example: MongoDB stores unstructured data in flexible JSON-like documents.
example_lao: MongoDB ເກັບຂໍ້ມູນແບບ Document JSON ທີ່ປັບປ່ຽນໄດ້ງ່າຍ.

meaning: ຖານຂໍ້ມູນ ໃນໜ່ວຍຄວາມຈຳ
example: Redis provides microsecond in-memory caching and session management.
example_lao: Redis ເປັນ In-memory Cache ທີ່ເຮັດວຽກໄວລະດັບໄມໂຄຣວິນາທີ.

meaning: ພາສາສອບຖາມຖານຂໍ້ມູນ
example: SQL queries filter and aggregate relational database tables.
example_lao: SQL ໃຊ້ສອບຖາມ, ກັ່ນຕອງ ແລະ ຄິດໄລ່ຂໍ້ມູນໃນຕາຕະລາງ.

meaning: ຖານຂໍ້ມູນແບບ
example: NoSQL databases scale horizontally across distributed clusters.
example_lao: ຖານຂໍ້ມູນ NoSQL ຂະຫຍາຍຮອງຮັບຂໍ້ມູນໃຫຍ່ໄດ້ງ່າຍ.

meaning: ໂຄງສ້າງຖານຂໍ້ມູນ
example: The database schema defines tables, fields, and relationships.
example_lao: Schema ກຳນົດຕາຕະລາງ, ຟິວ ແລະ ຄວາມສຳພັນຂອງຂໍ້ມູນ.

meaning: ຄີຫຼັກ
example: Every record in the table has a unique primary key.
example_lao: ທຸກໆແຖວຂໍ້ມູນໃນຕາຕະລາງມີ Primary Key ທີ່ບໍ່ຊ້ຳກັນ.

meaning: ຄີນອກ
example: A foreign key creates a relationship between two tables.
example_lao: Foreign Key ສ້າງຄວາມເຊື່ອມໂຍງລະຫວ່າງສອງຕາຕະລາງ.

meaning: ດັດສະນີຖານຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Adding an index accelerates search queries dramatically.
example_lao: ການສ້າງ Index ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ຄົ້ນຫາຂໍ້ມູນໃນຖານຂໍ້ມູນໄດ້ໄວຂຶ້ນຫຼາຍ.

meaning: ຄຳສັ່ງສອບຖາມ
example: The search query returned matching products in five milliseconds.
example_lao: Query ຄົ້ນຫາສົ່ງຄືນລາຍການສິນຄ້າພາຍໃນ 5 ມິນລີວິນາທີ.

meaning: ການປັບປ່ຽນໂຄງສ້າງຖານຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Run database migrations before deploying new code to production.
example_lao: ແລ່ນ Migration ຖານຂໍ້ມູນກ່ອນ Deploy ໂຄ້ດໃໝ່ຂຶ້ນລະບົບຈິງ.

meaning: ທຸລະກຳຖານຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Database transactions ensure money transfers are completely safe.
example_lao: Transaction ຮັບປະກັນວ່າການໂອນເງິນຈະສຳເລັດຢ່າງສົມບູນ.

meaning: ຄຸນສົມບັດ ຂອງຖານຂໍ້ມູນ
example: ACID guarantees data reliability even during power failures.
example_lao: ACID ຮັບປະກັນຄວາມຖືກຕ້ອງຂອງຂໍ້ມູນເຖິງວ່າໄຟຈະດັບ.

meaning: ການຈັດລະບຽບຖານຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Normalization eliminates redundant duplicate data across tables.
example_lao: Normalization ຫຼຸດຄວາມຊ້ຳຊ້ອນຂອງຂໍ້ມູນໃນຕາຕະລາງ.

meaning: ການແຍກສ່ວນຖານຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Database sharding distributes data rows across multiple servers.
example_lao: Sharding ແຍກແຈກຢາຍຂໍ້ມູນໄປໄວ້ຫຼາຍໆເຊີບເວີ.

meaning: ການສຳເນົາຖານຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Database replication provides high availability and backup redundancy.
example_lao: Replication ຊ່ວຍສຳເນົາຂໍ້ມູນໄວ້ຫຼາຍບ່ອນເພື່ອປ້ອງກັນຂໍ້ມູນເສຍ.

meaning: ລະບົບແປງຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Prisma ORM provides type-safe database queries in TypeScript.
example_lao: Prisma ORM ຊ່ວຍຂຽນ Query ຖານຂໍ້ມູນດ້ວຍ TypeScript ແບບປອດໄພ.

meaning: ສາງຂໍ້ມູນໃຫຍ່
example: The data warehouse consolidates historical data for corporate analytics.
example_lao: Data Warehouse ລວມຂໍ້ມູນປະຫວັດສາດເພື່ອການວິເຄາະທຸລະກິດ.

meaning: ແຫຼ່ງເກັບຂໍ້ມູນດິບ
example: Data lakes store petabytes of raw structured and unstructured files.
example_lao: Data Lake ເກັບກຳຂໍ້ມູນດິບທຸກຮູບແບບຂະໜາດໃຫຍ່.

meaning: ຂະບວນການ ດຶງ-ແປງ-ໂຫຼດຂໍ້ມູນ
example: The ETL pipeline cleans raw logs and loads them into Snowflake.
example_lao: ETL Pipeline ເຮັດຄວາມສະອາດຂໍ້ມູນແລ້ວໂຫຼດເຂົ້າ Snowflake.

meaning: ຂໍ້ມູນຂະໜາດມະຫາສານ
example: Big data analytics reveals hidden consumer behavior patterns.
example_lao: ການວິເຄາະ Big Data ຊ່ວຍເຫັນພຶດຕິກຳຂອງຜູ້ບໍລິໂພກ.

meaning: ແພລັດຟອມ
example: Snowflake enables scalable cloud data warehousing.
example_lao: Snowflake ແມ່ນລະບົບສາງຂໍ້ມູນ Cloud ທີ່ຂະຫຍາຍໄດ້ງ່າຍ.

meaning: ຖານຂໍ້ມູນເວັກເຕີ
example: Vector databases store AI embeddings for semantic search.
example_lao: Vector Database ເກັບ Embedding ຂອງ AI ສຳລັບການຄົ້ນຫາຄວາມໝາຍ.

meaning: ພື້ນທີ່ເກັບໄຟລ໌ຂະໜາດໃຫຍ່
example: Store user uploaded videos in S3 blob storage.
example_lao: ເກັບໄຟລ໌ວິດີໂອທີ່ຜູ້ໃຊ້ອັບໂຫຼດໄວ້ໃນ S3 Blob Storage.

meaning: ການຮຽນຮູ້ຂອງເຄື່ອງ
example: Machine learning models learn patterns from historical training data.
example_lao: ໂມເດວ Machine Learning ຮຽນຮູ້ຮູບແບບຈາກຂໍ້ມູນໃນອະດີດ.

meaning: ການຮຽນຮູ້ເຊິ່ງເລິກ
example: Deep learning powers modern speech recognition and image generation.
example_lao: Deep Learning ຂັບເຄື່ອນລະບົບຮັບຮູ້ສຽງ ແລະ ການສ້າງຮູບພາບ.

meaning: ໂຄງຂ່າຍປະສາດທຽມ
example: Artificial neural networks are inspired by biological brain neurons.
example_lao: ໂຄງຂ່າຍປະສາດທຽມໄດ້ຮັບແຮງບັນດານໃຈຈາກສະໝອງມະນຸດ.

meaning: ໂມເດວພາສາຂະໜາດໃຫຍ່
example: Large Language Models understand and generate fluent human text.
example_lao: LLM ເຂົ້າໃຈ ແລະ ສ້າງຂໍ້ຄວາມພາສາມະນຸດໄດ້ຢ່າງຄ່ອງແຄ້ວ.

meaning: ສ້າງສັນເນື້ອຫາ
example: Generative AI produces realistic images, code, and music.
example_lao: Generative AI ສາມາດສ້າງຮູບພາບ, ຂຽນໂຄ້ດ ແລະ ແຕ່ງເພງໄດ້.

meaning: ຄຳສັ່ງ ສໍາລັບ
example: Writing a precise prompt yields higher quality AI answers.
example_lao: ການຂຽນ Prompt ທີ່ຊັດເຈນຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ AI ຕອບໄດ້ດີຂຶ້ນ.

meaning: ວິສະວະກຳການອອກແບບ
example: Prompt engineering optimizes instructions to steer AI behavior.
example_lao: Prompt Engineering ແມ່ນການອອກແບບຄຳສັ່ງເພື່ອໃຫ້ AI ເຮັດວຽກໄດ້ດີທີ່ສຸດ.

meaning: ໂທເຄັນ / ໜ່ວຍຄຳສັບໃນ
example: LLMs process text by breaking sentences into numerical tokens.
example_lao: LLM ປະມວນຜົນຂໍ້ຄວາມໂດຍແບ່ງປະໂຫຍກອອກເປັນ Token.

meaning: ເວັກເຕີຄວາມໝາຍ
example: Word embeddings convert semantic meanings into multi-dimensional vectors.
example_lao: Embedding ປ່ຽນຄວາມໝາຍຂອງຄຳສັບໃຫ້ເປັນຕົວເລກ Vector.

meaning: ສະຖາປັດຕະຍະກຳ
example: The transformer architecture revolutionized modern natural language processing.
example_lao: Transformer ປະຕິວັດວົງການປະມວນຜົນພາສາທຳມະຊາດ.

meaning: ກົນໄກ ໃນ
example: Self-attention allows the model to focus on related words in context.
example_lao: Self-attention ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ AI ໂຟກັສຄຳສັບທີ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງກັນໃນປະໂຫຍກ.

meaning: ການຝຶກສອນ ເພີ່ມເຕີມ
example: Fine-tuning adapts a base model for specific medical diagnoses.
example_lao: Fine-Tuning ປັບແຕ່ງໂມເດວໃຫ້ຊ່ຽວຊານສະເພາະດ້ານການແພດ.

meaning: ຊຸດຂໍ້ມູນຝຶກສອນ
example: The training dataset contains millions of annotated high-resolution images.
example_lao: ຊຸດຂໍ້ມູນຝຶກສອນບັນຈຸຮູບພາບຄວາມລະອຽດສູງຫຼາຍລ້ານຮູບ.

meaning: ພາວະ (ຈຳເກີນໄປ)
example: Overfitting happens when a model memorizes noise instead of general patterns.
example_lao: Overfitting ເກີດຂຶ້ນເມື່ອໂມເດວຈື່ຂໍ້ມູນເກົ່າຫຼາຍເກີນໄປຈົນໃຊ້ກັບຂໍ້ມູນໃໝ່ບໍ່ດີ.

meaning: ພາວະ (ຮຽນຮູ້ບໍ່ພໍ)
example: Underfitting occurs when the machine learning model is too simple.
example_lao: Underfitting ເກີດຂຶ້ນເມື່ອໂມເດວຮຽນຮູ້ຂໍ້ມູນໄດ້ໜ້ອຍເກີນໄປ.

meaning: ການຮຽນຮູ້ແບບມີຜູ້ສອນ
example: Supervised learning maps input features to labeled target answers.
example_lao: ການຮຽນຮູ້ແບບມີຜູ້ສອນໃຊ້ຂໍ້ມູນທີ່ມີການຕິດປ້າຍກຳກັບຄຳຕອບ.

meaning: ການຮຽນຮູ້ແບບບໍ່ມີຜູ້ສອນ
example: Unsupervised learning discovers hidden clusters in unlabeled datasets.
example_lao: ການຮຽນຮູ້ແບບບໍ່ມີຜູ້ສອນຊ່ວຍຈັດກຸ່ມຂໍ້ມູນທີ່ບໍ່ມີປ້າຍກຳກັບ.

meaning: ການຮຽນຮູ້ແບບເສີມກຳລັງ
example: Reinforcement learning trains robots through rewards and penalties.
example_lao: Reinforcement Learning ຝຶກສອນຫຸ່ນຍົນຜ່ານການໃຫ້ລາງວັນ ແລະ ການລົງໂທດ.

meaning: ການປັບ ຕາມຄຳຕິຊົມມະນຸດ
example: RLHF aligns AI conversational tone with human ethical values.
example_lao: RLHF ປັບພຶດຕິກຳ AI ໃຫ້ສອດຄ່ອງກັບຄ່ານິຍົມຂອງມະນຸດ.

meaning: ການເບິ່ງເຫັນຂອງຄອມພິວເຕີ
example: Computer vision enables self-driving cars to recognize stop signs.
example_lao: Computer Vision ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ລົດຂັບເຄື່ອນອັດຕະໂນມັດມອງເຫັນປ້າຍຈະລາຈອນ.

meaning: ການປະມວນຜົນພາສາທຳມະຊາດ
example: NLP powers automated translation tools and voice assistants.
example_lao: NLP ຂັບເຄື່ອນເຄື່ອງມືແປພາສາອັດຕະໂນມັດ ແລະ ຜູ້ຊ່ວຍສຽງ.

meaning: ການຮັບຮູ້ສຽງເວົ້າ
example: Speech recognition transcribes spoken English words into text accurately.
example_lao: Speech Recognition ແປງສຽງເວົ້າພາສາອັງກິດເປັນຂໍ້ຄວາມໄດ້ຢ່າງຖືກຕ້ອງ.

meaning: ລະບົບແນະນຳສິນຄ້າ/ເນື້ອຫາ
example: The recommendation system suggests videos matching your personal taste.
example_lao: ລະບົບແນະນຳຈະເລືອກວິດີໂອທີ່ກົງກັບຄວາມມັກຂອງທ່ານ.

meaning: ອາການ ຫຼອນ / ຕອບບໍ່ຈິງ
example: Always verify facts because language models can occasionally hallucinate.
example_lao: ກວດສອບຂໍ້ມູນສະເໝີ ເພາະ AI ອາດຈະໃຫ້ຂໍ້ມູນທີ່ບໍ່ຖືກຕ້ອງໄດ້.

meaning: ຂະໜາດໜ່ວຍຄວາມຈຳບໍລິບົດ
example: A 128k context window allows analyzing entire books in one prompt.
example_lao: Context Window ຂະໜາດ 128k ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ວິເຄາະປຶ້ມໄດ້ທັງຫົວ.

meaning: ເທັກໂນໂລຊີ ດຶງຂໍ້ມູນມາຕອບ
example: RAG connects internal enterprise documents directly to language models.
example_lao: RAG ເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ເອກະສານພາຍໃນບໍລິສັດເຂົ້າກັບ AI ເພື່ອຕອບຄຳຖາມ.

meaning: ລະບົບ ແບບ ລົງມືເຮັດເອງ
example: Agentic AI breaks complex workflows into autonomous actionable steps.
example_lao: Agentic AI ແບ່ງວຽກຍາກໆອອກເປັນຂັ້ນຕອນ ແລະ ລົງມືເຮັດເອງອັດຕະໂນມັດ.

meaning: ລະບົບ ຮອງຮັບຫຼາຍຮູບແບບ
example: Multimodal AI processes text, audio, image, and video inputs together.
example_lao: Multimodal AI ຮອງຮັບທັງຂໍ້ຄວາມ, ສຽງ, ຮູບພາບ ແລະ ວິດີໂອພ້ອມກັນ.

meaning: ເຟຣມເວິກ ສຳລັບ
example: Researchers use PyTorch to build state-of-the-art AI architectures.
example_lao: ນັກວິໄຈໃຊ້ PyTorch ເພື່ອສ້າງໂຄງສ້າງ AI ລະດັບໂລກ.

meaning: ເຟຣມເວິກ
example: TensorFlow deploys machine learning models to production servers.
example_lao: TensorFlow ນຳໃຊ້ໂມເດວ Machine Learning ຂຶ້ນສູ່ລະບົບຈິງ.

meaning: ເທັກໂນໂລຊີ ຂອງ
example: CUDA accelerates deep learning computations on NVIDIA GPUs.
example_lao: CUDA ເລັ່ງການປະມວນຜົນ Deep Learning ເທິງກາດຈໍ NVIDIA.

meaning: ການປະມວນຜົນໂມເດວ
example: AI inference speed determines real-time chatbot responsiveness.
example_lao: ຄວາມໄວ Inference ຂອງ AI ກຳນົດຄວາມໄວໃນການຕອບແຊັດ.

meaning: ການບີບອັດຂະໜາດໂມເດວ
example: Quantization reduces 16-bit model weights into 4-bit without losing accuracy.
example_lao: Quantization ຫຼຸດຂະໜາດໂມເດວ AI ໃຫ້ກິນແຮມໜ້ອຍລົງ.

meaning: ການທົດສອບປະສິດທິພາບມາດຕະຖານ
example: The new AI model scored highest on academic reasoning benchmarks.
example_lao: ໂມເດວ AI ໃໝ່ໄດ້ຄະແນນສູງສຸດໃນການທົດສອບ Benchmark.

meaning: ແພລັດຟອມ
example: Developers download pre-trained open-source AI weights from Hugging Face.
example_lao: ນັກພັດທະນາດາວໂຫຼດໂມເດວ AI ແບບ Open-source ຈາກ Hugging Face.

meaning: ເຄືອຂ່າຍສ່ວນຕົວສະເໝືອນ
example: A VPN encrypts your internet traffic on public Wi-Fi networks.
example_lao: VPN ເຂົ້າລະຫັດຂໍ້ມູນອິນເຕີເນັດຂອງທ່ານເທິງ Wi-Fi ສາທາລະນະ.

meaning: ພຣັອກຊີເຊີບເວີ
example: A proxy server hides your real IP address from visited websites.
example_lao: Proxy Server ຊ່ວຍເຊື່ອງເລກ IP ທີ່ແທ້ຈິງຂອງທ່ານ.

meaning: ໂປຣແກຣມປ້ອງກັນໄວຣັສ
example: Install an antivirus program to scan downloads for threats.
example_lao: ຕິດຕັ້ງໂປຣແກຣມແອນຕີ້ໄວຣັສເພື່ອກວດສອບໄຟລ໌ທີ່ດາວໂຫຼດ.

meaning: ການຫຼອກລວງເອົາຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Beware of phishing emails asking for your online banking password.
example_lao: ລະວັງອີເມວ Phishing ທີ່ຫຼອກຖາມລະຫັດຜ່ານທະນາຄານ.

meaning: ໄວຣັສຮຽກຄ່າໄຖ່
example: Ransomware locks files until victims pay a cryptocurrency ransom.
example_lao: Ransomware ລັອກໄຟລ໌ເພື່ອຮຽກຄ່າໄຖ່ເປັນເງິນດິຈິຕອນ.

meaning: ໂທຣຈັນ / ໂປຣແກຣມແຝງຕົວ
example: A Trojan horse disguises itself as legitimate software.
example_lao: Trojan ແຝງຕົວມາໃນຮູບແບບໂປຣແກຣມທີ່ໜ້າເຊື່ອຖື.

meaning: ໂປຣແກຣມລັກລອບດັກຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Spyware secretly tracks keystrokes and steals private credentials.
example_lao: Spyware ລັກຕິດຕາມການກົດແປ້ນພິມ ແລະ ຂະໂມຍລະຫັດຜ່ານ.

meaning: ການໂຈມຕີແບບ ເຮັດໃຫ້ລະບົບຫຼົ້ມ
example: A massive DDoS attack overwhelmed the website with fake traffic.
example_lao: ການໂຈມຕີ DDoS ຍິງ Traffic ປອມຈົນເວັບໄຊຫຼົ້ມ.

meaning: ເຄືອຂ່າຍຄອມພິວເຕີຕິດເຊື້ອ
example: Hackers control botnets to launch coordinated cyber attacks.
example_lao: ແຮັກເກີຄວບຄຸມ Botnet ເພື່ອໂຈມຕີລະບົບພ້ອມກັນ.

meaning: ຊ່ອງໂຫວ່ - ທີ່ຍັງບໍ່ມີແພັດຊ໌ແກ້
example: Zero-day vulnerabilities require immediate emergency software patches.
example_lao: ຊ່ອງໂຫວ່ Zero-Day ຕ້ອງການ Patch ແກ້ໄຂດ່ວນທີ່ສຸດ.

meaning: ການທົດສອບເຈາະລະບົບ
example: Ethical hackers conduct penetration testing to find weak spots.
example_lao: ແຮັກເກີສາຍຂາວເຮັດ Penetration Testing ເພື່ອຊອກຫາຈຸດອ່ອນ.

meaning: ການຖອດລະຫັດຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Enter your private key to complete data decryption.
example_lao: ປ້ອນ Private Key ເພື່ອຖອດລະຫັດຂໍ້ມູນ.

meaning: ໃບຢັ້ງຢືນຄວາມປອດໄພ
example: An SSL certificate establishes an encrypted HTTPS green lock.
example_lao: ໃບຢັ້ງຢືນ SSL ສ້າງການເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ HTTPS ທີ່ປອດໄພ.

meaning: ໂປຣໂຕຄໍຄວາມປອດໄພ
example: TLS 1.3 provides modern cryptographic security over internet.
example_lao: TLS 1.3 ໃຫ້ຄວາມປອດໄພໃນການເຂົ້າລະຫັດຂໍ້ມູນເທິງອິນເຕີເນັດ.

meaning: ໂປຣໂຕຄໍ ປອດໄພ
example: Always look for HTTPS in the address bar when shopping online.
example_lao: ກວດເບິ່ງ HTTPS ສະເໝີເມື່ອຊື້ເຄື່ອງອອນລາຍ.

meaning: ໝາຍເລກໄອພີ
example: Every internet-connected device has a unique numerical IP address.
example_lao: ທຸກອຸປະກອນທີ່ຕໍ່ເນັດມີໝາຍເລກ IP ສະເພາະຕົວ.

meaning: ເຄືອຂ່າຍຍ່ອຍ
example: Network administrators divide company computers into isolated subnets.
example_lao: ຜູ້ດູແລລະບົບແບ່ງຄອມພິວເຕີອອກເປັນເຄືອຂ່າຍຍ່ອຍ.

meaning: ລະບົບແປງຊື່ເວັບໄຊ
example: DNS translates domain names into machine-readable IP addresses.
example_lao: DNS ແປງຊື່ເວັບໄຊໃຫ້ເປັນໝາຍເລກ IP.

meaning: ໂປຣໂຕຄໍແຈກໄອພີ
example: The DHCP server assigns local IP addresses automatically.
example_lao: DHCP Server ແຈກຢາຍໝາຍເລກ IP ໃຫ້ອຸປະກອນໂດຍອັດຕະໂນມັດ.

meaning: ໝາຍເລກຮາດແວ
example: The router filters connections based on physical MAC address.
example_lao: ຣາວເຕີກັ່ນຕອງການເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ຕາມໝາຍເລກ MAC Address.

meaning: ແພັກເກັດຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Data travels across the internet divided into small digital packets.
example_lao: ຂໍ້ມູນເດີນທາງຜ່ານເນັດໂດຍຖືກແບ່ງເປັນ Packet ນ້ອຍໆ.

meaning: ການລະບຸຕົວຕົນດ້ວຍຊີວະມິຕິ
example: Face ID and fingerprint unlock are biometric security methods.
example_lao: ການສະແກນໃບໜ້າ ແລະ ລາຍນິ້ວມືແມ່ນລະບົບ Biometrics.

meaning: ສະຖາປັດຕະຍະກຳ (ບໍ່ເຊື່ອໃຈໃຜ)
example: Zero Trust architecture verifies identity continuously on every access.
example_lao: Zero Trust ກວດສອບຕົວຕົນຢ່າງຕໍ່ເນື່ອງໃນທຸກການເຂົ້າເຖິງ.

meaning: ແຜນຮັບມືເຫດການໄພຄຸກຄາມ
example: The cybersecurity team executed their incident response playbook.
example_lao: ທີມໄຊເບີປະຕິບັດຕາມແຜນຮັບມືເຫດການສຸກເສີນ.

meaning: ລະບົບກວດຈັບການບຸກລຸກ
example: Intrusion detection systems alert engineers to unauthorized breaches.
example_lao: ລະບົບ IDS ແຈ້ງເຕືອນເມື່ອມີການບຸກລຸກທີ່ບໍ່ໄດ້ຮັບອະນຸຍາດ.

meaning: ສູນປະຕິບັດການຄວາມປອດໄພ
example: The 24/7 Security Operations Center monitors network traffic.
example_lao: ສູນ SOC ຕິດຕາມຄວາມປອດໄພຂອງລະບົບຕະຫຼອດ 24 ຊົ່ວໂມງ.

meaning: ຊ່ອງໂຫວ່ຄວາມປອດໄພ
example: Security researchers discovered a critical vulnerability in the library.
example_lao: ນັກວິໄຈພົບຊ່ອງໂຫວ່ຮ້າຍແຮງໃນໄລບຣາຣີ.

meaning: ແພັດຊ໌ແກ້ໄຂລະບົບ
example: Install the security patch immediately to protect your server.
example_lao: ຕິດຕັ້ງ Security Patch ທັນທີເພື່ອປົກປ້ອງເຊີບເວີ.

meaning: ລະບົບຄອນເທນເນີ
example: Docker packages applications and their dependencies into portable containers.
example_lao: Docker ຫຸ້ມຫໍ່ແອັບ ແລະ ສິ່ງທີ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງເຂົ້າໃນ Container ທີ່ຍົກຍ້າຍໄດ້ງ່າຍ.

meaning: ຄອນເທນເນີ
example: Containers isolate running code from underlying operating systems.
example_lao: Container ແຍກສະພາບແວດລ້ອມການເຮັດວຽກຂອງໂຄ້ດອອກເປັນສັດສ່ວນ.

meaning: ລະບົບຈັດການຄອນເທນເນີ
example: Kubernetes automates container deployment, scaling, and management.
example_lao: Kubernetes ຈັດການ ແລະ ຂະຫຍາຍ Container ໂດຍອັດຕະໂນມັດ.

meaning: ເຄື່ອງມືສ້າງພື້ນຖານໂຄງລ່າງ
example: Terraform provisions cloud servers using infrastructure-as-code files.
example_lao: Terraform ສ້າງ Cloud Server ດ້ວຍການຂຽນໂຄ້ດຄວບຄຸມ.

meaning: ເຄື່ອງມືຕັ້ງຄ່າອັດຕະໂນມັດ
example: Ansible configures thousands of Linux servers simultaneously.
example_lao: Ansible ຕັ້ງຄ່າເຊີບເວີ Linux ຫຼາຍພັນເຄື່ອງພ້ອມກັນ.

meaning: ແພລັດຟອມ
example: GitHub hosts millions of open-source software repositories.
example_lao: GitHub ເປັນບ່ອນເກັບໂຄ້ດໂຄງການ Open-source ຫຼາຍລ້ານໂຄງການ.

meaning: ລະບົບຄວບຄຸມເວີຊັນ
example: Git tracks code revisions and allows seamless collaboration.
example_lao: Git ຕິດຕາມປະຫວັດການແກ້ໄຂໂຄ້ດ ແລະ ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ເຮັດວຽກຮ່ວມກັນໄດ້.

meaning: ການບັນທຶກການປ່ຽນແປງ
example: Write descriptive commit messages to explain your code changes.
example_lao: ຂຽນ Commit Message ທີ່ຊັດເຈນເພື່ອອະທິບາຍການປ່ຽນແປງໂຄ້ດ.

meaning: ກິ່ງແຍກພັດທະນາໂຄ້ດ
example: Create a feature branch before developing new functionality.
example_lao: ສ້າງ Feature Branch ກ່ອນເລີ່ມພັດທະນາຟັງຊັນໃໝ່.

meaning: ການລວມໂຄ້ດ
example: Merge your completed feature branch back into the main branch.
example_lao: ລວມ Branch ທີ່ເຮັດແລ້ວເຂົ້າສູ່ Main Branch.

meaning: ການຮ້ອງຂໍກວດສອບ ແລະ ລວມໂຄ້ດ
example: Team members review code before approving the pull request.
example_lao: ສະມາຊິກໃນທີມກວດສອບໂຄ້ດກ່ອນອະນຸມັດ Pull Request.

meaning: ບ່ອນເກັບໂຄ້ດ
example: Clone the Git repository to start working locally.
example_lao: Clone ບ່ອນເກັບໂຄ້ດ Git ເພື່ອເລີ່ມເຮັດວຽກໃນເຄື່ອງ.

meaning: ຂະບວນການ ອັດຕະໂນມັດ
example: The build pipeline failed because one unit test was broken.
example_lao: Pipeline ສ້າງໂຄ້ດຫຼົ້ມ ເພາະມີ Unit Test ບໍ່ຜ່ານ.

meaning: ການປ່ອຍໂຄ້ດຂຶ້ນລະບົບ
example: Zero-downtime deployment ensures continuous service for active users.
example_lao: ການ Deploy ແບບ Zero-downtime ເຮັດໃຫ້ລະບົບບໍ່ສະດຸດ.

meaning: ເຄື່ອງສະເໝືອນ
example: Virtual machines simulate complete independent guest operating systems.
example_lao: Virtual Machine ຈຳລອງລະບົບປະຕິບັດການຂຶ້ນມາໃນເຄື່ອງດຽວ.

meaning: ຕົວແຈກຢາຍພາລະ
example: A load balancer distributes network traffic across multiple backend servers.
example_lao: Load Balancer ແຈກຢາຍ Traffic ໄປຫາເຊີບເວີຫຼາຍໆເຄື່ອງ.

meaning: ເຄືອຂ່າຍກະຈາຍເນື້ອຫາ
example: A CDN delivers static assets from edge servers close to users.
example_lao: CDN ສົ່ງໄຟລ໌ຈາກ Edge Server ທີ່ຢູ່ໃກ້ຜູ້ໃຊ້ທີ່ສຸດ.

meaning: ເວັບເຊີບເວີ
example: Nginx serves static files and acts as an efficient reverse proxy.
example_lao: Nginx ເຮັດໜ້າທີ່ເປັນ Web Server ແລະ Reverse Proxy ທີ່ມີປະສິດທິພາບ.

meaning: ຄວາມໜ່ວງ / ເວລາຕອບສະໜອງ
example: Low latency is critical for competitive online multiplayer games.
example_lao: ຄວາມໜ່ວງຕ່ຳມີຄວາມສຳຄັນຫຼາຍສຳລັບເກມອອນລາຍ.

meaning: ປະລິມານຂໍ້ມູນທີ່ສົ່ງໄດ້
example: Network throughput measures total data transferred per second.
example_lao: Throughput ວັດແທກປະລິມານຂໍ້ມູນທີ່ສົ່ງໄດ້ຕໍ່ວິນາທີ.

meaning: ເວລາທີ່ລະບົບເຮັດວຽກຕໍ່ເນື່ອງ
example: The cloud host guarantees ninety-nine point nine percent uptime.
example_lao: Cloud ຮັບປະກັນວ່າລະບົບຈະເຮັດວຽກຕໍ່ເນື່ອງ 99.9%.

meaning: ການຕິດຕາມກວດກາລະບົບ
example: Prometheus monitors CPU usage and memory consumption in real time.
example_lao: Prometheus ຕິດຕາມການໃຊ້ງານ CPU ແລະ Memory ແບບ Real-time.

meaning: ແດຊບອດ
example: Engineers build Grafana dashboards to visualize server metrics.
example_lao: ວິສະວະກອນສ້າງແດຊບອດ Grafana ເພື່ອເບິ່ງກຣາບປະສິດທິພາບເຊີບເວີ.

meaning: ລະບົບຕິດຕາມ
example: Sentry captures frontend crashes and notifies developers immediately.
example_lao: Sentry ຈັບພາບ Error ເທິງໜ້າເວັບ ແລະ ແຈ້ງເຕືອນນັກພັດທະນາທັນທີ.

meaning: ການບັນທຶກລັອກ
example: Comprehensive logging helps trace bugs and security anomalies.
example_lao: ການເກັບ Log ຢ່າງລະອຽດຊ່ວຍໃນການແກ້ໄຂ Bug ແລະ ກວດສອບຄວາມປອດໄພ.

meaning: ການແກ້ໄຂຈຸດຜິດພາດ
example: Debugging code requires patience and systematic thinking.
example_lao: ການ Debug ໂຄ້ດຕ້ອງອາໄສຄວາມອົດທົນ ແລະ ການຄິດຢ່າງເປັນລະບົບ.

meaning: ເຄື່ອງມືກວດສອບຮູບແບບໂຄ້ດ
example: The linter enforces consistent code style across the engineering team.
example_lao: Linter ບັງຄັບຮູບແບບການຂຽນໂຄ້ດໃຫ້ເປັນມາດຕະຖານດຽວກັນ.

meaning: ເຄື່ອງມືຈັດຮູບແບບໂຄ້ດ
example: Prettier is a popular code formatter that formats files automatically.
example_lao: Prettier ແມ່ນເຄື່ອງມືຈັດຮູບແບບໂຄ້ດອັດຕະໂນມັດທີ່ນິຍົມ.

meaning: ໂປຣແກຣມຂຽນໂຄ້ດ
example: Visual Studio Code is a powerful and customizable IDE.
example_lao: VS Code ແມ່ນໂປຣແກຣມຂຽນໂຄ້ດທີ່ຊົງພະລັງ ແລະ ປັບແຕ່ງໄດ້ຫຼາກຫຼາຍ.

meaning: ການປັບປຸງໂຄງສ້າງໂຄ້ດ
example: Refactoring code improves readability without changing external behavior.
example_lao: Refactoring ປັບປຸງໂຄງສ້າງໂຄ້ດໃຫ້ນັກພັດທະນາອ່ານງ່າຍຂຶ້ນ.

meaning: ການທົດສອບໂຄ້ດລະດັບຢູນິດ
example: Unit testing verifies that individual functions work correctly.
example_lao: Unit Testing ທົດສອບວ່າແຕ່ລະຟັງຊັນເຮັດວຽກຖືກຕ້ອງ.

meaning: ການທົດສອບການເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ລະບົບ
example: Integration testing checks if database and API modules work together.
example_lao: Integration Testing ກວດສອບວ່າຖານຂໍ້ມູນ ແລະ API ເຮັດວຽກຮ່ວມກັນໄດ້.

meaning: ໜີ້ສິນທາງເທັກນິກ
example: Ignoring technical debt leads to fragile and unmaintainable code.
example_lao: ການປ່ອຍປະ Technical Debt ເຮັດໃຫ້ໂຄ້ດແກ້ໄຂຍາກໃນອະນາຄົດ.

meaning: ວິທີການເຮັດວຽກແບບ
example: Agile methodology delivers working software in short iterative sprints.
example_lao: Agile ຊ່ວຍສົ່ງມອບຊອບແວເປັນຮອບໆຢ່າງວ່ອງໄວ.

meaning: ຂະບວນການ
example: The Scrum team meets daily for a fifteen minute standup.
example_lao: ທີມ Scrum ປະຊຸມ Standup ປະຈຳວັນ 15 ນາທີ.

meaning: ຮອບການເຮັດວຽກ
example: We planned five critical user stories for the upcoming sprint.
example_lao: ພວກເຮົາໄດ້ວາງແຜນ 5 User Story ສຳລັບ Sprint ທີ່ຈະມາເຖິງ.

meaning: ລາຍການວຽກທີ່ຕ້ອງເຮັດ
example: The product manager prioritizes tickets in the sprint backlog.
example_lao: ຜູ້ຈັດການຜະລິດຕະພັນຈັດລຳດັບຄວາມສຳຄັນຂອງວຽກໃນ Backlog.

meaning: ການປະຊຸມອັບເດດສັ້ນ
example: During the standup, each developer shared progress and blockers.
example_lao: ໃນການປະຊຸມ Standup ທຸກຄົນໄດ້ແບ່ງປັນຄວາມຄືບໜ້າ ແລະ ບັນຫາຕິດຂັດ.

meaning: ເລື່ອງລາວຄວາມຕ້ອງການຂອງຜູ້ໃຊ້
example: A user story defines feature requirements from user perspective.
example_lao: User Story ອະທິບາຍຄວາມຕ້ອງການຟີເຈີຈາກມຸມມອງຂອງຜູ້ໃຊ້.

meaning: ພາບໂຄງຮ່າງໜ້າຕາລະບົບ
example: Designers create low-fidelity wireframes before building prototypes.
example_lao: ນັກອອກແບບສ້າງ Wireframe ເພື່ອເບິ່ງໂຄງສ້າງກ່ອນສ້າງຕົ້ນແບບ.

meaning: ຕົ້ນແບບທົດລອງ
example: We tested the interactive prototype with ten beta testers.
example_lao: ພວກເຮົາໄດ້ທົດສອບ Prototype ກັບຜູ້ໃຊ້ກຸ່ມທົດລອງ 10 ຄົນ.

meaning: ແບບຈຳລອງພາບຕົວຈິງ
example: The UI mockup shows exact typography, colors, and shadows.
example_lao: Mockup ສະແດງຮູບແບບສີສັນ ແລະ ຕົວອັກສອນຕົວຈິງ.

meaning: ການທົດສອບຄວາມງ່າຍໃນການໃຊ້ງານ
example: Usability testing reveals confusing navigation and layout pain points.
example_lao: Usability Testing ຊ່ວຍຊອກຫາຈຸດທີ່ຜູ້ໃຊ້ສັບສົນ.

meaning: ໂໝດມືດ
example: Dark mode reduces eye strain during late night coding.
example_lao: Dark Mode ຊ່ວຍຖະໜອມສາຍຕາເວລານັ່ງເຮັດວຽກຕອນກາງຄືນ.

meaning: ຊຸດເທັກໂນໂລຊີທີ່ເລືອກໃຊ້
example: Our tech stack includes Next.js, Tailwind, and PostgreSQL.
example_lao: Tech Stack ຂອງພວກເຮົາປະກອບມີ Next.js, Tailwind ແລະ PostgreSQL.

meaning: ຊອບແວລະຫັດເປີດ
example: Open source software allows global developers to inspect and contribute.
example_lao: Open Source ອະນຸຍາດໃຫ້ນັກພັດທະນາທົ່ວໂລກຮ່ວມກັນພັດທະນາ.

meaning: ແພັກເກັດທີ່ຂຶ້ນຕໍ່ກັນ
example: Update project dependencies regularly to patch security flaws.
example_lao: ອັບເດດ Dependency ຂອງໂປຣເຈັກເປັນປະຈຳເພື່ອປ້ອງກັນຊ່ອງໂຫວ່.

meaning: ຕົວຈັດການແພັກເກັດ
example: NPM is the default package manager for Node.js ecosystem.
example_lao: NPM ແມ່ນຕົວຈັດການແພັກເກັດມາດຕະຖານສຳລັບ Node.js.

meaning: ການເອີ້ນຟັງຊັນຊ້ຳຕົວເອງ
example: Recursion solves tree traversal problems cleanly and elegantly.
example_lao: Recursion ຊ່ວຍແກ້ໄຂບັນຫາແບບ Tree ໄດ້ຢ່າງສະອາດ.

meaning: ອາເຣ / ລາຍການລຽງລຳດັບ
example: An array stores a sequential list of indexed values.
example_lao: Array ເກັບກຳລາຍການຂໍ້ມູນຕາມລຳດັບ Index.

meaning: ອອບເຈັກ
example: JavaScript objects store key-value data properties.
example_lao: Object ໃນ JavaScript ເກັບຂໍ້ມູນແບບ Key-Value.

meaning: ຟັງຊັນ
example: Functions encapsulate reusable code blocks with input parameters.
example_lao: ຟັງຊັນລວມໂຄ້ດທີ່ນຳມາໃຊ້ໃໝ່ໄດ້ພ້ອມຮັບ Parameter.

meaning: ຕົວປ່ຽນ
example: Declare variables with const or let in modern JavaScript.
example_lao: ປະກາດຕົວປ່ຽນດ້ວຍ const ຫຼື let ໃນ JavaScript ຍຸກໃໝ່.

meaning: ຄ່າຄົງທີ່
example: Constants cannot be reassigned once initialized.
example_lao: ຄ່າຄົງທີ່ບໍ່ສາມາດປ່ຽນແປງຄ່າໄດ້ຫຼັງຈາກກຳນົດແລ້ວ.

meaning: ລູບ / ການເຮັດຊ້ຳ
example: A for loop iterates over each item in the collection.
example_lao: For Loop ຊ່ວຍວົນລູບເຮັດວຽກກັບທຸກຂໍ້ມູນໃນລາຍການ.

meaning: ຄອນແບັກ
example: Pass a callback function to handle asynchronous response.
example_lao: ສົ່ງ Callback Function ເພື່ອຈັດການຜົນລັບ Asynchronous.

meaning: ໂປຣມິສ
example: Promises represent the eventual completion of asynchronous operations.
example_lao: Promise ເປັນຕົວແທນຂອງຜົນລັບການເຮັດວຽກແບບ Asynchronous.

meaning: ຂອບເຂດການເຂົ້າເຖິງຕົວປ່ຽນ
example: Block scope restricts variable visibility inside curly braces.
example_lao: Block Scope ຈຳກັດການເຂົ້າເຖິງຕົວປ່ຽນສະເພາະໃນວົງເລັບປີກກາ.

meaning: ອິນເຕີເນັດຂອງສັບພະສິ່ງ
example: The Internet of Things connects household appliances to the web.
example_lao: IoT ເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ເຄື່ອງໃຊ້ພາຍໃນບ້ານເຂົ້າສູ່ລະບົບອິນເຕີເນັດ.

meaning: ບ້ານອັດສະລິຍະ
example: Smart home devices allow controlling air conditioners from smartphones.
example_lao: ອຸປະກອນ Smart Home ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ຄວບຄຸມແອຜ່ານມືຖືໄດ້.

meaning: ໂມງອັດສະລິຍະ
example: My smartwatch monitors heart rate, sleep quality, and daily steps.
example_lao: ໂມງອັດສະລິຍະຂອງຂ້ອຍວັດແທກອັດຕາການເຕັ້ນຫົວໃຈ ແລະ ການນອນ.

meaning: ຄວາມເປັນຈິງເສີມ
example: Augmented reality overlays digital graphics onto real-world camera views.
example_lao: AR ສະແດງພາບກຣາບຟິກຊ້ອນທັບເທິງໂລກຕົວຈິງ.

meaning: ຄວາມເປັນຈິງສະເໝືອນ
example: Virtual reality headsets immerse players in interactive 3D worlds.
example_lao: ແວ່ນ VR ພາຜູ້ຫຼິ້ນເຂົ້າສູ່ໂລກ 3D ແບບສົມຈິງ.

meaning: ເມຕາເວີຣສ / ໂລກສະເໝືອນ
example: Avatars interact with friends in the digital metaverse universe.
example_lao: ຕົວລະຄອນ Avatar ພົບປະກັບໝູ່ເພື່ອນໃນໂລກດິຈິຕອນ Metaverse.

meaning: ຍານພາຫະນະຂັບເຄື່ອນອັດຕະໂນມັດ
example: Autonomous vehicles navigate city traffic using cameras and LIDAR.
example_lao: ລົດຂັບເຄື່ອນອັດຕະໂນມັດເດີນທາງຕາມຖະໜົນໂດຍໃຊ້ກ້ອງ ແລະ LIDAR.

meaning: ເຊັນເຊີໄລດາ
example: LIDAR pulses laser beams to create precision 3D spatial maps.
example_lao: LIDAR ຍິງເລເຊີເພື່ອສ້າງແຜນທີ່ 3 ມິຕິທີ່ມີຄວາມຊັດເຈນສູງ.

meaning: ໂດຣນ / ອາກາດສະຍານໄຮ້ຄົນຂັບ
example: Drones capture stunning aerial video footage and deliver packages.
example_lao: ໂດຣນຖ່າຍພາບມຸມສູງທີ່ສວຍງາມ ແລະ ໃຊ້ຈັດສົ່ງພັດສະດຸ.

meaning: ວິທະຍາການຫຸ່ນຍົນ
example: Robotics streamlines manufacturing in modern automated factories.
example_lao: ວິທະຍາການຫຸ່ນຍົນຊ່ວຍເພີ່ມປະສິດທິພາບໃນໂຮງງານອັດຕະໂນມັດ.

meaning: ເທັກໂນໂລຊີບລັອກເຊນ
example: Blockchain creates a decentralized tamper-proof ledger of records.
example_lao: Blockchain ສ້າງລະບົບບັນທຶກຂໍ້ມູນແບບກະຈາຍສູນທີ່ແກ້ໄຂບໍ່ໄດ້.

meaning: ສັນຍາອັດສະລິຍະ
example: Smart contracts execute automatically when agreed terms are fulfilled.
example_lao: Smart Contract ເຮັດວຽກອັດຕະໂນມັດເມື່ອເງື່ອນໄຂຄົບຖ້ວນ.

meaning: ເງິນດິຈິຕອນ / ຄຣິບໂຕເຄີເຣນຊີ
example: Bitcoin and Ethereum are the two largest cryptocurrencies.
example_lao: Bitcoin ແລະ Ethereum ແມ່ນສອງສະກຸນເງິນດິຈິຕອນທີ່ໃຫຍ່ທີ່ສຸດ.

meaning: ເທັກໂນໂລຊີການເງິນ
example: Fintech apps enable seamless international money transfers.
example_lao: ແອັບ Fintech ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ໂອນເງິນຂ້າມປະເທດໄດ້ຢ່າງສະດວກ.

meaning: ການສື່ສານໄຮ້ສາຍໄລຍະໃກ້
example: Tap your phone on the payment terminal using NFC.
example_lao: ແຕະໂທລະສັບຂອງທ່ານໃສ່ເຄື່ອງຮູດບັດດ້ວຍເທັກໂນໂລຊີ NFC.

meaning: ລະຫັດຄິວອາ
example: Scan the QR code to view the restaurant menu instantly.
example_lao: ສະແກນ QR Code ເພື່ອເບິ່ງເມນູອາຫານຂອງຮ້ານໄດ້ທັນທີ.

meaning: ເຄື່ອງສະແກນຊີວະມິຕິ
example: The airport installed biometric scanners for express passport control.
example_lao: ສະໜາມບິນຕິດຕັ້ງເຄື່ອງສະແກນຊີວະມິຕິເພື່ອຜ່ານດ່ານໄວຂຶ້ນ.

meaning: ອຸປະກອນສວມໃສ່ອັດສະລິຍະ
example: Wearables track personal health and daily fitness metrics.
example_lao: ອຸປະກອນສວມໃສ່ຊ່ວຍຕິດຕາມສຸຂະພາບ ແລະ ການອອກກຳລັງກາຍ.

meaning: ລະບົບອັດຕະໂນມັດ
example: Industrial automation improves production speed and safety.
example_lao: ລະບົບອັດຕະໂນມັດຊ່ວຍເພີ່ມຄວາມໄວ ແລະ ຄວາມປອດໄພໃນການຜະລິດ.

meaning: ການປະມວນຜົນເຊິ່ງພື້ນທີ່
example: Spatial computing blends digital apps seamlessly into physical rooms.
example_lao: Spatial Computing ຜະສານແອັບດິຈິຕອນເຂົ້າກັບຫ້ອງຕົວຈິງ.

meaning: ການແພດທາງໄກ
example: Telemedicine connects rural patients with specialist doctors over video.
example_lao: Telemedicine ເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ຄົນເຈັບໃນເຂດຫ່າງໄກສອກຫຼີກກັບທ່ານໝໍຜ່ານວິດີໂອ.

meaning: ເທັກໂນໂລຊີການສຶກສາ
example: EdTech platforms provide interactive online courses to worldwide learners.
example_lao: EdTech ໃຫ້ຄອສຮຽນອອນລາຍແບບໂຕ້ຕອບແກ່ຜູ້ຮຽນທົ່ວໂລກ.

meaning: ກ່ອງສະຕຣີມມິ່ງ
example: Plug the streaming box into HDMI to watch 4K shows.
example_lao: ສຽບກ່ອງສະຕຣີມມິ່ງເຂົ້າພອດ HDMI ເພື່ອເບິ່ງລາຍການ 4K.

meaning: ເຄື່ອງຄວບຄຸມອຸນຫະພູມອັດສະລິຍະ
example: A smart thermostat learns your schedule to save heating energy.
example_lao: ເຄື່ອງຄວບຄຸມອຸນຫະພູມອັດສະລິຍະຮຽນຮູ້ຕາຕະລາງຂອງທ່ານເພື່ອປະຢັດໄຟ.

meaning: ລັອກປະຕູອັດສະລິຍະ
example: Unlock your front door using a smartphone keypad or fingerprint.
example_lao: ປົດລັອກປະຕູໜ້າບ້ານດ້ວຍໂທລະສັບ ຫຼື ລາຍນິ້ວມື.

meaning: ເຄື່ອງອ່ານປຶ້ມດິຈິຕອນ
example: An e-reader screen mimics real paper without harmful glare.
example_lao: ໜ້າຈໍ E-Reader ສະແດງຜົນຄ້າຍຄືເຈ້ຍແທ້ໂດຍບໍ່ສະທ້ອນແສງ.

meaning: ສາຍເຄເບິນໃຍແກ້ວນຳແສງ
example: Fiber optic internet delivers gigabit download and upload speeds.
example_lao: ອິນເຕີເນັດໃຍແກ້ວນຳແສງໃຫ້ຄວາມໄວດາວໂຫຼດລະດັບກິກະບິດ.

meaning: ສະຖາປັດຕະຍະກຳ
example: Microservice architecture scales independent modules reliably.
example_lao: ສະຖາປັດຕະຍະກຳ Microservice ຊ່ວຍຂະຫຍາຍລະບົບໄດ້ດີ.

meaning: ອີເວັ້ນລູບ
example: The JavaScript event loop coordinates non-blocking asynchronous execution.
example_lao: Event Loop ໃນ JavaScript ຈັດການການເຮັດວຽກແບບ Asynchronous.

meaning: ລະບົບລ້າງໜ່ວຍຄວາມຈຳ
example: Automatic garbage collection frees up unused memory heap.
example_lao: Garbage Collection ຊ່ວຍຄືນພື້ນທີ່ Memory ທີ່ບໍ່ໄດ້ໃຊ້ແລ້ວ.

meaning: ການຮົ່ວໄຫຼຂອງໜ່ວຍຄວາມຈຳ
example: Unclosed database connections cause severe memory leaks.
example_lao: ການເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ຖານຂໍ້ມູນທີ່ບໍ່ໄດ້ປິດເຮັດໃຫ້ເກີດ Memory Leak.

meaning: ຂໍ້ຜິດພາດ
example: Infinite recursion causes a fatal stack overflow crash.
example_lao: ການເອີ້ນຟັງຊັນຊ້ຳບໍ່ມີທີ່ສິ້ນສຸດເຮັດໃຫ້ເກີດ Stack Overflow.

meaning: ຂໍ້ຜິດພາດ
example: Always check object existence to prevent null pointer errors.
example_lao: ກວດສອບຕົວປ່ຽນສະເໝີເພື່ອປ້ອງກັນ Null Pointer Error.

meaning: ພາວະຕິດລັອກ
example: Two processes blocked each other, causing a database deadlock.
example_lao: ສອງໂປຣເຊສຕິດລັອກກັນເຮັດໃຫ້ເກີດ Deadlock ໃນຖານຂໍ້ມູນ.

meaning: ພາວະແຂ່ງຂັນແຍ່ງຊັບພະຍາກອນ
example: Mutex locks prevent race conditions in concurrent multi-threaded programs.
example_lao: Mutex Lock ຊ່ວຍປ້ອງກັນ Race Condition ໃນໂປຣແກຣມທີ່ແລ່ນຫຼາຍ Thread.

meaning: ເທຣດ / ສາຍການປະມວນຜົນ
example: Multi-threading utilizes all CPU cores for parallel computations.
example_lao: Multi-threading ໃຊ້ງານທຸກ Core ຂອງ CPU ເພື່ອປະມວນຜົນພ້ອມກັນ.

meaning: ການປະມວນຜົນແບບພ້ອມກັນ
example: Go language handles millions of concurrent lightweight routines.
example_lao: ພາສາ Go ຈັດການ Concurrency ໄດ້ຫຼາຍລ້ານລາຍການ.

meaning: ການເຮັດວຽກແບບບໍ່ລໍຖ້າ
example: Asynchronous I/O keeps web applications responsive under load.
example_lao: Asynchronous I/O ເຮັດໃຫ້ເວັບຕອບສະໜອງໄດ້ດີ.

meaning: ການເຮັດວຽກແບບລໍຖ້າຕາມລຳດັບ
example: Synchronous code blocks execution until the current task finishes.
example_lao: ໂຄ້ດ Synchronous ຈະລໍຖ້າໃຫ້ວຽກປັດຈຸບັນສຳເລັດກ່ອນ.

meaning: ຫຼັກການໂພລີມໍຟິຊຶມໃນ
example: Polymorphism allows different classes to share identical method signatures.
example_lao: Polymorphism ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ Class ຕ່າງໆໃຊ້ Method ຊື່ດຽວກັນໄດ້.

meaning: ການຫຸ້ມຫໍ່ຂໍ້ມູນໃນ
example: Encapsulation hides internal object states behind public methods.
example_lao: Encapsulation ຊ່ວຍປົກປ້ອງຂໍ້ມູນພາຍໃນ Object.

meaning: ການສືບທອດຄຸນສົມບັດໃນ
example: Inheritance enables subclasses to reuse parent class logic.
example_lao: Inheritance ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ Class ລູກສືບທອດ Logic ຈາກ Class ແມ່.

meaning: ການຕັດຄວາມຊັບຊ້ອນໃນ
example: Abstraction exposes simplified interfaces while hiding underlying implementation.
example_lao: Abstraction ສະແດງສະເພາະສິ່ງທີ່ຈຳເປັນ ແລະ ເຊື່ອງຄວາມຊັບຊ້ອນໄວ້.

meaning: ແບບແຜນການອອກແບບໂຄ້ດ
example: The Singleton design pattern restricts class instantiation to one instance.
example_lao: Design Pattern ແບບ Singleton ຮັບປະກັນວ່າຈະມີພຽງ Instance ດຽວ.

meaning: ແບບແຜນ
example: Factory patterns create objects without specifying exact concrete classes.
example_lao: Factory Pattern ຊ່ວຍສ້າງ Object ໂດຍບໍ່ຕ້ອງລະບຸ Class ໂດຍກົງ.

meaning: ແບບແຜນ
example: Event emitters utilize the observer pattern to notify listeners.
example_lao: Observer Pattern ໃຊ້ແຈ້ງເຕືອນເມື່ອມີ Event ເກີດຂຶ້ນ.

meaning: ການສີດ ເຂົ້າໃນໂຄ້ດ
example: Dependency injection makes testing and mocking components easy.
example_lao: Dependency Injection ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ການຂຽນ Unit Test ແລະ Mock ງ່າຍຂຶ້ນ.

meaning: ຄອມໄພເລີ / ຕົວແປພາສາໂຄ້ດ
example: The compiler translates source code into machine executable binary.
example_lao: Compiler ແປງ Source Code ເປັນໄຟລ໌ Binary ທີ່ເຄື່ອງແລ່ນໄດ້.

meaning: ອິນເຕີພຣີເຕີ / ຕົວແປໂຄ້ດແຕ່ລະແຖວ
example: Python uses an interpreter to execute instructions line by line.
example_lao: Python ໃຊ້ Interpreter ໃນການແລ່ນໂຄ້ດເທື່ອລະແຖວ.

meaning: ໄວຍາກອນໂຄ້ດ
example: A missing semicolon caused a syntax error in the script.
example_lao: ການຂາດເຄື່ອງໝາຍຈຸດຈ້ຳເຮັດໃຫ້ເກີດ Syntax Error.

meaning: ໄລຍະເວລາແລ່ນໂຄ້ດ
example: Runtime errors occur while the program is actively executing.
example_lao: Runtime Error ເກີດຂຶ້ນຂະນະທີ່ໂປຣແກຣມກຳລັງແລ່ນຢູ່.

meaning: ໂຄ້ດໂຄງສ້າງພື້ນຖານ
example: Starter templates provide boilerplate code for fast project setup.
example_lao: Starter Template ໃຫ້ໂຄ້ດ Boilerplate ເພື່ອເລີ່ມຕົ້ນໂປຣເຈັກໄດ້ໄວ.

meaning: ຖືກຍົກເລີກການໃຊ້ງານ
example: The legacy API method is deprecated and will be removed soon.
example_lao: Method ເກົ່ານີ້ Deprecated ແລ້ວ ແລະ ຈະຖືກລຶບອອກໃນໄວໆນີ້.

meaning: ໂຄ້ດເກົ່າຕົກທອດ
example: Refactoring legacy code requires comprehensive automated regression tests.
example_lao: ການແກ້ໄຂໂຄ້ດເກົ່າ Legacy Code ຕ້ອງອາໄສ Automated Test ທີ່ຄົບຖ້ວນ.

meaning: ຈຸດຢຸດກວດສອບໂຄ້ດ
example: Set a breakpoint in the debugger to inspect variable values.
example_lao: ວາງ Breakpoint ໃນ Debugger ເພື່ອກວດສອບຄ່າຂອງຕົວປ່ຽນ.

meaning: ລຳດັບການເອີ້ນໂຄ້ດຕອນເກີດ
example: The stack trace pinpointed the exact line where the exception occurred.
example_lao: Stack Trace ຊີ້ບອກແຖວທີ່ເກີດ Error ໄດ້ຢ່າງຊັດເຈນ.

meaning: ການວັດແທກປະສິດທິພາບໂຄ້ດ
example: Memory profiling identified heavy memory allocation bottlenecks.
example_lao: Memory Profiling ຊ່ວຍຊອກຫາຈຸດທີ່ກິນແຮມຫຼາຍເກີນໄປ.

meaning: ເວີຊັນຂອງ
example: Upgrade your Android SDK version to target newer devices.
example_lao: ອັບເກຣດ Android SDK ເພື່ອຮອງຮັບອຸປະກອນລຸ້ນໃໝ່.

meaning: ບ່ອນເກັບແພັກເກັດ
example: Publish your library to the public NPM package registry.
example_lao: ເຜີຍແຜ່ໄລບຣາຣີຂອງທ່ານລົງໃນ NPM Registry.

meaning: ລະບົບກຳນົດເວີຊັນ
example: Semantic versioning uses Major.Minor.Patch numerical format.
example_lao: SemVer ໃຊ້ຮູບແບບເວີຊັນ Major.Minor.Patch.

meaning: ໂມໂນຣີໂປ / ບ່ອນເກັບຫຼາຍໂປຣເຈັກໃນບ່ອນດຽວ
example: Monorepos manage frontend, backend, and shared libraries together.
example_lao: Monorepo ເກັບທັງ Frontend, Backend ແລະ ໄລບຣາຣີໄວ້ຮ່ວມກັນ.

meaning: ໂຄ້ດເສີມຮອງຮັບບຣາວເຊີເກົ່າ
example: Polyfills enable modern JavaScript features on legacy web browsers.
example_lao: Polyfill ຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ບຣາວເຊີເກົ່າໃຊ້ຟີເຈີ JavaScript ໃໝ່ໆໄດ້.

meaning: ການຕັດໂຄ້ດທີ່ບໍ່ໄດ້ໃຊ້ອອກ
example: Tree shaking eliminates dead code to optimize production bundle size.
example_lao: Tree Shaking ຕັດໂຄ້ດທີ່ບໍ່ໄດ້ໃຊ້ອອກເພື່ອຫຼຸດຂະໜາດໄຟລ໌.

meaning: ການອັບເດດໂຄ້ດທັນທີໂດຍບໍ່ຣີໂຫຼດ
example: Hot reloading updates modified components instantly in the browser.
example_lao: Hot Reloading ອັບເດດ Component ທັນທີເທິງບຣາວເຊີ.

meaning: ແຜນທີ່ໂຄ້ດຕົ້ນສະບັບ
example: Source maps map minified production bundle back to original TypeScript files.
example_lao: Source Map ຊ່ວຍ Map ໂຄ້ດທີ່ຖືກບີບອັດກັບມາເປັນ TypeScript ຕົ້ນສະບັບ.

meaning: ການປ່ອຍຟີເຈີແບບລັບໆ
example: Dark launching tests new backend pipelines with live production traffic.
example_lao: Dark Launch ທົດສອບລະບົບໃໝ່ກັບ Traffic ຈິງແບບງຽບໆ.

meaning: ສະວິດເປີດ-ປິດຟີເຈີ
example: Feature flags toggle new capabilities on or off dynamically.
example_lao: Feature Flag ຊ່ວຍເປີດ-ປິດຟີເຈີໃໝ່ໄດ້ທັນທີໂດຍບໍ່ຕ້ອງ Deploy ໃໝ່.

meaning: ຄລາວເນທີບ
example: Cloud native apps leverage containers, microservices, and serverless.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Cloud native apps leverage containers, microservices, and serverless.

meaning: ມັລຕິຄລາວ
example: A multi-cloud strategy prevents vendor lock-in across AWS and Azure.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: A multi-cloud strategy prevents vendor lock-in across AWS and Azure.

meaning: ໄຮບຣິດຄລາວ
example: Hybrid cloud combines on-premise servers with public cloud infrastructure.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Hybrid cloud combines on-premise servers with public cloud infrastructure.

meaning: ການຍ້າຍລະບົບຂຶ້ນຄລາວ
example: Cloud migration reduced company hardware maintenance expenses.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Cloud migration reduced company hardware maintenance expenses.

meaning: ບັກເກັດເກັບຂໍ້ມູນຄລາວ
example: Configure bucket permissions to prevent public data exposure.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Configure bucket permissions to prevent public data exposure.

meaning: ຈຸດກະຈາຍສັນຍານ
example: Edge locations cache content close to end users globally.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Edge locations cache content close to end users globally.

meaning: ຖານຂໍ້ມູນແບບ
example: Serverless databases scale capacity automatically based on query load.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Serverless databases scale capacity automatically based on query load.

meaning: ບ່ອນເກັບຮູບພາບຄອນເທນເນີ
example: Push built Docker images to the secure container registry.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Push built Docker images to the secure container registry.

meaning: ຕາໜ່າງເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ບໍລິການ
example: Istio service mesh manages traffic, security, and observability.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Istio service mesh manages traffic, security, and observability.

meaning: ຕົວຂະຫຍາຍຄລັສເຕີອັດຕະໂນມັດ
example: The cluster autoscaler adds worker nodes during traffic spikes.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: The cluster autoscaler adds worker nodes during traffic spikes.

meaning: ການເລີ່ມຕົ້ນແບບ
example: Optimize function package size to reduce serverless cold starts.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Optimize function package size to reduce serverless cold starts.

meaning: ພື້ນຖານໂຄງລ່າງໃນຮູບແບບໂຄ້ດ
example: Infrastructure as code ensures repeatable and version-controlled environments.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Infrastructure as code ensures repeatable and version-controlled environments.

meaning: ແຜນກູ້ຄືນລະບົບເມື່ອເກີດໄພພິບັດ
example: The disaster recovery plan guarantees data restoration within one hour.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: The disaster recovery plan guarantees data restoration within one hour.

meaning: ຄວາມພ້ອມໃຊ້ງານສູງ
example: High availability architecture eliminates single points of failure.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: High availability architecture eliminates single points of failure.

meaning: ຄີເຂົ້າລະຫັດແບບສົມມາດ
example: Symmetric key encryption uses the same shared key for encryption and decryption.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Symmetric key encryption uses the same shared key for encryption and decryption.

meaning: ຄີເຂົ້າລະຫັດແບບອະສົມມາດ
example: Asymmetric cryptography utilizes public and private key pairs.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Asymmetric cryptography utilizes public and private key pairs.

meaning: ຟັງຊັນແຮຊ
example: SHA-256 is a cryptographic one-way hash function.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: SHA-256 is a cryptographic one-way hash function.

meaning: ຄ່າ ເພີ່ມຄວາມປອດໄພລະຫັດຜ່ານ
example: Salting passwords protects against precomputed rainbow table attacks.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Salting passwords protects against precomputed rainbow table attacks.

meaning: ລາຍເຊັນດິຈິຕອນ
example: Digital signatures verify the authenticity and integrity of messages.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Digital signatures verify the authenticity and integrity of messages.

meaning: ໜ່ວຍງານອອກໃບຢັ້ງຢືນ
example: Certificate Authorities issue trusted digital identity certificates.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Certificate Authorities issue trusted digital identity certificates.

meaning: ໂປຣແກຣມດັກຈັບການພິມ
example: Keyloggers record sensitive passwords entered on infected keyboards.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Keyloggers record sensitive passwords entered on infected keyboards.

meaning: ຣູດຄິດ / ໂປຣແກຣມຝັງຕົວໃນລະບົບ
example: Rootkits give malicious attackers hidden administrator privileges.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Rootkits give malicious attackers hidden administrator privileges.

meaning: ແອດແວ / ໂປຣແກຣມໂຄສະນາແຝງ
example: Adware injects unwanted pop-up advertisements into web browsers.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Adware injects unwanted pop-up advertisements into web browsers.

meaning: ຊ່ອງໂຫວ່
example: Sanitize user inputs to protect web apps from XSS attacks.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Sanitize user inputs to protect web apps from XSS attacks.

meaning: ການໂຈມຕີ
example: Use parameterized queries to eliminate SQL injection vulnerabilities.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Use parameterized queries to eliminate SQL injection vulnerabilities.

meaning: ການໂຈມຕີ
example: CSRF tokens protect authenticated forms from unauthorized submissions.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: CSRF tokens protect authenticated forms from unauthorized submissions.

meaning: ການຫຼອກໃຫ້ກົດປຸ່ມ
example: X-Frame-Options headers protect web pages against clickjacking.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: X-Frame-Options headers protect web pages against clickjacking.

meaning: ການສຸ່ມລະຫັດຜ່ານ
example: Account lockouts stop automated brute force login attempts.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Account lockouts stop automated brute force login attempts.

meaning: ການລັກລອງລະຫັດຜ່ານທີ່ຮົ່ວໄຫຼ
example: Credential stuffing tests leaked passwords across multiple services.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Credential stuffing tests leaked passwords across multiple services.

meaning: ໄຮເປີພາຣາມິເຕີໃນ
example: Tuning hyperparameters like learning rate improves model accuracy.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Tuning hyperparameters like learning rate improves model accuracy.

meaning: ຟັງຊັນຄິດໄລ່ຄວາມຜິດພາດ
example: The loss function measures the difference between prediction and actual label.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: The loss function measures the difference between prediction and actual label.

meaning: ວິທີ
example: Gradient descent minimizes error by adjusting neural weights iteratively.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Gradient descent minimizes error by adjusting neural weights iteratively.

meaning: ການສົ່ງຄ່າຜິດພາດກັບຄືນ
example: Backpropagation computes gradients through deep neural layers.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Backpropagation computes gradients through deep neural layers.

meaning: ຟັງຊັນກະຕຸ້ນ
example: ReLU is the most common non-linear activation function in deep learning.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: ReLU is the most common non-linear activation function in deep learning.

meaning: ໂຄງຂ່າຍ ສຳລັບຮູບພາບ
example: CNNs excel at image recognition, object classification, and computer vision.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: CNNs excel at image recognition, object classification, and computer vision.

meaning: ໂຄງຂ່າຍ ສຳລັບຂໍ້ຄວາມ
example: RNNs process sequential time-series data and sequential sentences.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: RNNs process sequential time-series data and sequential sentences.

meaning: ໂຄງຂ່າຍ ສ້າງຮູບພາບ
example: GANs pit generator and discriminator networks against each other.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: GANs pit generator and discriminator networks against each other.

meaning: ໂຄງຂ່າຍ ບີບອັດຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Autoencoders compress input data into low-dimensional latent representations.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Autoencoders compress input data into low-dimensional latent representations.

meaning: ພື້ນທີ່ແຝງ
example: Diffusion models generate images by sampling from compressed latent space.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Diffusion models generate images by sampling from compressed latent space.

meaning: ໂມເດວ ສ້າງຮູບພາບ
example: Stable Diffusion creates photorealistic artworks from descriptive prompts.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Stable Diffusion creates photorealistic artworks from descriptive prompts.

meaning: ການຕັດຄຳສັບເປັນໂທເຄັນ
example: Byte-pair encoding tokenization splits unknown words into subword units.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Byte-pair encoding tokenization splits unknown words into subword units.

meaning: ການຄືນຮູບຄຳສັບສູ່ຮາກເດີມ
example: Lemmatization converts inflected verbs into their base dictionary form.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Lemmatization converts inflected verbs into their base dictionary form.

meaning: ການວິເຄາະຄວາມຮູ້ສຶກ
example: Sentiment analysis classifies user reviews as positive, neutral, or negative.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Sentiment analysis classifies user reviews as positive, neutral, or negative.

meaning: ການບີບຄວາມໄວອິນເຕີເນັດ
example: ISPs may throttle bandwidth during peak network congestion hours.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: ISPs may throttle bandwidth during peak network congestion hours.

meaning: ເຄືອຂ່າຍແບບຕາໜ່າງ
example: Mesh Wi-Fi systems eliminate dead zones across large multi-story houses.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Mesh Wi-Fi systems eliminate dead zones across large multi-story houses.

meaning: ໂປຣແກຣມດັກຈັບແພັກເກັດ
example: Wireshark is an industry standard packet sniffer network analyzer.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Wireshark is an industry standard packet sniffer network analyzer.

meaning: ການສົ່ງຕໍ່ພອດ
example: Configure port forwarding on the router to host home game servers.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Configure port forwarding on the router to host home game servers.

meaning: ໄອພີແບບຄົງທີ່
example: Servers and network printers require static IP addresses for stability.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Servers and network printers require static IP addresses for stability.

meaning: ໄອພີແບບປ່ຽນແປງໄດ້
example: Most home internet connections use dynamic IP addresses assigned by ISP.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Most home internet connections use dynamic IP addresses assigned by ISP.

meaning: ສະວິດເຄືອຂ່າຍ
example: Gigabit network switches connect multiple Ethernet devices locally.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Gigabit network switches connect multiple Ethernet devices locally.

meaning: ສາຍແພັດເຄເບິນ
example: Cat 6 patch cables support data rates up to 10 gigabits per second.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Cat 6 patch cables support data rates up to 10 gigabits per second.

meaning: ຈຸດກະຈາຍສັນຍານ -
example: Ceiling-mounted access points provide seamless roaming in office buildings.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Ceiling-mounted access points provide seamless roaming in office buildings.

meaning: ການຈ່າຍໄຟຜ່ານສາຍແລນ
example: PoE delivers electrical power and network data through one cable.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: PoE delivers electrical power and network data through one cable.

meaning: ປັກສຽບໄຟອັດສະລິຍະ
example: Smart plugs let you schedule electrical appliances from your smartphone.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Smart plugs let you schedule electrical appliances from your smartphone.

meaning: ດອກໄຟອັດສະລິຍະ
example: Change smart bulb colors and brightness using voice commands.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Change smart bulb colors and brightness using voice commands.

meaning: ໂປຣໂຕຄໍ ສຳລັບ
example: Zigbee is a low-power wireless protocol for home automation devices.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Zigbee is a low-power wireless protocol for home automation devices.

meaning: ມາດຕະຖານກາງ ສຳລັບ
example: Matter protocol ensures interoperability across Apple, Google, and Amazon devices.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Matter protocol ensures interoperability across Apple, Google, and Amazon devices.

meaning: ການອັບເດດເຟີມແວ
example: Regular firmware updates improve device performance and patch security bugs.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Regular firmware updates improve device performance and patch security bugs.

meaning: ໜ່ວຍຄວາມຈຳ ທີ່ລຶບ ແລະ ຂຽນໃໝ່ໄດ້
example: EEPROM retains configuration settings even when power is disconnected.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: EEPROM retains configuration settings even when power is disconnected.

meaning: ໜ່ວຍຄວາມຈຳແບບແຟລຊ
example: USB drives and memory cards use non-volatile flash memory.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: USB drives and memory cards use non-volatile flash memory.

meaning: ໜ່ວຍຄວາມຈຳແຄຊ
example: L3 cache memory provides ultra-fast data access to CPU cores.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: L3 cache memory provides ultra-fast data access to CPU cores.

meaning: ໜ່ວຍຄວາມຈຳສະເໝືອນ
example: Virtual memory uses disk space when physical RAM runs out.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Virtual memory uses disk space when physical RAM runs out.

meaning: ການແບ່ງໜ້າໜ່ວຍຄວາມຈຳ
example: The operating system manages memory allocation using paging schemes.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: The operating system manages memory allocation using paging schemes.

meaning: ເທັກໂນໂລຊີ ລວມຮາດດິດ
example: RAID 1 mirrors data across two hard drives for fault tolerance.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: RAID 1 mirrors data across two hard drives for fault tolerance.

meaning: ອຸປະກອນເກັບຂໍ້ມູນເທິງເຄືອຂ່າຍ
example: A network-attached storage (NAS) provides centralized home backups.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: A network-attached storage  provides centralized home backups.

meaning: ເຄືອຂ່າຍພື້ນທີ່ເກັບຂໍ້ມູນ
example: Enterprise data centers rely on storage area networks for high throughput.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Enterprise data centers rely on storage area networks for high throughput.

meaning: ສາຍໃຍແກ້ວນຳແສງ
example: Optical fiber cables transmit data signals at the speed of light.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Optical fiber cables transmit data signals at the speed of light.

meaning: ສາຍໂຄແອກຊຽວ
example: Coaxial cables connect cable modems to television provider networks.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Coaxial cables connect cable modems to television provider networks.

meaning: ແອັບພລິເຄຊັນແບບ
example: Native iOS apps built with Swift deliver optimal graphics performance.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Native iOS apps built with Swift deliver optimal graphics performance.

meaning: ແອັບພລິເຄຊັນແບບ
example: Hybrid apps combine web technologies inside a native webview container.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Hybrid apps combine web technologies inside a native webview container.

meaning: ຂ້າມແພລັດຟອມ
example: Flutter enables building cross-platform apps from a single codebase.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Flutter enables building cross-platform apps from a single codebase.

meaning: ໄຟລ໌ຕິດຕັ້ງແອັບ
example: Download the signed APK file to install the app on Android devices.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Download the signed APK file to install the app on Android devices.

meaning: ຮ້ານຄ້າແອັບ
example: Submit your mobile app for review on Apple App Store and Google Play.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Submit your mobile app for review on Apple App Store and Google Play.

meaning: ການຊື້ສິນຄ້າພາຍໃນແອັບ
example: In-app purchases allow users to unlock premium subscription features.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: In-app purchases allow users to unlock premium subscription features.

meaning: ການແຈ້ງເຕືອນແບບ
example: Push notifications re-engage mobile users with breaking news alerts.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Push notifications re-engage mobile users with breaking news alerts.

meaning: ການເຊື່ອມໂຍງລິ້ງໂດຍກົງເຂົ້າສູ່ແອັບ
example: Deep linking directs users straight to specific in-app content screens.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Deep linking directs users straight to specific in-app content screens.

meaning: ການລະບຸຕຳແໜ່ງພູມສາດ
example: The maps application uses GPS geolocation to provide navigation directions.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: The maps application uses GPS geolocation to provide navigation directions.

meaning: ເຊັນເຊີວັດແຮງໂນ້ມຖ່ວງ ແລະ ຄວາມເລັ່ງ
example: The smartphone accelerometer rotates the screen when turned sideways.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: The smartphone accelerometer rotates the screen when turned sideways.

meaning: ຜູ້ໃຫ້ບໍລິການເຄືອຂ່າຍມືຖື
example: Telecom carriers are expanding high-speed 5G network towers.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Telecom carriers are expanding high-speed 5G network towers.

meaning: ຊິມກາດ
example: Insert the nano SIM card to activate your mobile phone plan.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Insert the nano SIM card to activate your mobile phone plan.

meaning: ຊິມດິຈິຕອນ
example: eSIM allows switching cellular network providers digitally without physical cards.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: eSIM allows switching cellular network providers digitally without physical cards.

meaning: ການໂຣມມິ່ງຂ້າມປະເທດ
example: International data roaming allows using mobile internet while traveling abroad.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: International data roaming allows using mobile internet while traveling abroad.

meaning: ຮັອດສະປອດ / ແບ່ງປັນເນັດ
example: Turn on your smartphone personal hotspot to share internet with your laptop.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Turn on your smartphone personal hotspot to share internet with your laptop.

meaning: ການແບ່ງປັນອິນເຕີເນັດຜ່ານສາຍ/ບລູທູດ
example: USB tethering provides a stable wired connection from mobile to PC.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: USB tethering provides a stable wired connection from mobile to PC.

meaning: ການໂທຜ່ານອິນເຕີເນັດ
example: VoIP services like Skype reduce long-distance telephone calling costs.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: VoIP services like Skype reduce long-distance telephone calling costs.

meaning: ເສົາສັນຍານມືຖື
example: 5G cell towers require dense placement due to shorter millimeter waves.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: 5G cell towers require dense placement due to shorter millimeter waves.

meaning: ໂມເດັມ
example: The modem converts cable signals into digital internet data packets.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: The modem converts cable signals into digital internet data packets.

meaning: ເພດານຈຳກັດປະລິມານເນັດ
example: Unlimited data plans do not have monthly bandwidth caps.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Unlimited data plans do not have monthly bandwidth caps.

meaning: ໄມໂຄຣໂຄ້ດໃນ
example: CPU microcode updates patch hardware-level security bugs.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: CPU microcode updates patch hardware-level security bugs.

meaning: ຄວາມໄວບັສ
example: Higher front-side bus speed accelerates memory data exchanges.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Higher front-side bus speed accelerates memory data exchanges.

meaning: ຮອບສັນຍານໂມງ
example: Modern processors execute billions of clock cycles per second.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Modern processors execute billions of clock cycles per second.

meaning: ຊຸດຄຳສັ່ງ
example: ARM and x86 are the two dominant CPU instruction set architectures.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: ARM and x86 are the two dominant CPU instruction set architectures.

meaning: ກຸ່ມເທຣດພ້ອມໃຊ້ງານ
example: Thread pools prevent the overhead of continuously spawning new OS threads.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Thread pools prevent the overhead of continuously spawning new OS threads.

meaning: ມິວເທັກສ໌
example: A mutex ensures exclusive access to shared memory variables.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: A mutex ensures exclusive access to shared memory variables.

meaning: ເຊມາຟໍ
example: Counting semaphores regulate concurrent access to finite resource pools.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Counting semaphores regulate concurrent access to finite resource pools.

meaning: ເດສທັອບສະເໝືອນ
example: Virtual desktop infrastructure allows secure remote work from anywhere.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Virtual desktop infrastructure allows secure remote work from anywhere.

meaning: ເຄື່ອງລູກຂ່າຍຂະໜາດນ້ອຍ
example: Thin clients rely on centralized cloud servers for all heavy processing.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Thin clients rely on centralized cloud servers for all heavy processing.

meaning: ຄອມພິວເຕີເມນເຟຣມ
example: Banking systems continue running critical financial records on mainframes.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Banking systems continue running critical financial records on mainframes.

meaning: ຊຸບເປີຄອມພິວເຕີ
example: Supercomputers simulate complex global weather and climate physics models.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Supercomputers simulate complex global weather and climate physics models.

meaning: ຄິວບິດ
example: Quantum computers use qubits that exist in multiple superposition states.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Quantum computers use qubits that exist in multiple superposition states.

meaning: ພາວະຊ້ອນທັບທາງຄວອນຕຳ
example: Quantum superposition enables evaluating exponential possibilities simultaneously.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Quantum superposition enables evaluating exponential possibilities simultaneously.

meaning: ການພົວພັນທາງຄວອນຕຳ
example: Quantum entanglement links particle states regardless of physical distance.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Quantum entanglement links particle states regardless of physical distance.

meaning: ຄວາມເໜືອກວ່າທາງຄວອນຕຳ
example: Quantum supremacy is reached when quantum systems outperform classical supercomputers.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Quantum supremacy is reached when quantum systems outperform classical supercomputers.

meaning: ນາໂນແມັດ
example: Leading foundries manufacture advanced chips using 3nm fabrication processes.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Leading foundries manufacture advanced chips using 3nm fabrication processes.

meaning: ຂະບວນການພິມລາຍວົງຈອນ
example: EUV lithography machines project ultra-fine microscopic circuit lines on silicon wafers.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: EUV lithography machines project ultra-fine microscopic circuit lines on silicon wafers.

meaning: ແຜ່ນຊິລິຄອນເວເຟີ
example: Semiconductor factories cut hundreds of microchips from each silicon wafer.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Semiconductor factories cut hundreds of microchips from each silicon wafer.

meaning: ໂຮງງານຜະລິດຊິບ
example: TSMC is the largest dedicated semiconductor foundry in the world.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: TSMC is the largest dedicated semiconductor foundry in the world.

meaning: ຫ້ອງສະອາດປອດຝຸ່ນ
example: Chip manufacturing takes place inside ultra-sterile dust-free cleanrooms.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Chip manufacturing takes place inside ultra-sterile dust-free cleanrooms.

meaning: ສະຖາປັດຕະຍະກຳຊອບແວ
example: Clean software architecture ensures codebases remain modular and scalable.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Clean software architecture ensures codebases remain modular and scalable.

meaning: ຫຼັກການແຍກໜ້າທີ່ຂອງໂຄ້ດ
example: Separation of concerns keeps presentation, business logic, and data layers decoupled.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Separation of concerns keeps presentation, business logic, and data layers decoupled.

meaning: ຫຼັກການ ບໍ່ຂຽນໂຄ້ດຊ້ຳ
example: The DRY principle advocates reusing functions instead of copy-pasting code.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: The DRY principle advocates reusing functions instead of copy-pasting code.

meaning: ຫຼັກການໜ້າທີ່ດຽວ
example: Each class should have only one single reason to change.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Each class should have only one single reason to change.

meaning: ຫຼັກການແທນທີ່ໄດ້ຂອງ ລູກ
example: Subclasses must be substitutable for their parent base classes seamlessly.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Subclasses must be substitutable for their parent base classes seamlessly.

meaning: ຫຼັກການແຍກອິນເຕີເຟສໃຫ້ກະທັດຮັດ
example: Clients should not be forced to depend on interfaces they do not use.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Clients should not be forced to depend on interfaces they do not use.

meaning: ຫຼັກການປີ້ນກັບຂອງ
example: High-level modules should depend on abstractions, not on concrete details.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: High-level modules should depend on abstractions, not on concrete details.

meaning: ດີໄຊໂທເຄັນ
example: Design tokens store brand colors, font sizes, and spacing constants.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Design tokens store brand colors, font sizes, and spacing constants.

meaning: ຫຼັກການອອກແບບ ແບບອາຕອມ
example: Atomic design organizes UI from basic atoms to complex page templates.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Atomic design organizes UI from basic atoms to complex page templates.

meaning: ກິ່ນຜິດປົກກະຕິໃນໂຄ້ດ
example: Duplicate logic and overly long functions are common code smells.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Duplicate logic and overly long functions are common code smells.

meaning: ໂຄ້ດທີ່ພັນກັນຫຍຸ້ງຍາກ
example: Spaghetti code lacks modular structure and is notoriously difficult to maintain.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Spaghetti code lacks modular structure and is notoriously difficult to maintain.

meaning: ອອບເຈັກທີ່ເຮັດວຽກທຸກຢ່າງ
example: Avoid creating god objects that control all application operations.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Avoid creating god objects that control all application operations.

meaning: ແບບແຜນການຂຽນໂຄ້ດທີ່ຄວນຫຼີກລ່ຽງ
example: Hardcoding database credentials inside source code is a major anti-pattern.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Hardcoding database credentials inside source code is a major anti-pattern.

meaning: ການທົດລອງສຶກສາໂຄ້ດ
example: The developer did a two-day research spike to evaluate new graph databases.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: The developer did a two-day research spike to evaluate new graph databases.

meaning: ໂຄງການພິສູດແນວຄິດ
example: We built a proof of concept to demonstrate AI feasibility to investors.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: We built a proof of concept to demonstrate AI feasibility to investors.

meaning: ຜະລິດຕະພັນລຸ້ນທຳອິດທີ່ໃຊ້ງານໄດ້
example: Launch the MVP quickly to gather real user feedback from early adopters.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Launch the MVP quickly to gather real user feedback from early adopters.

meaning: ເອກະສານກຳນົດສະເພາະທາງເທັກນິກ
example: Engineers review the technical specification document before writing production code.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Engineers review the technical specification document before writing production code.

meaning: ເອກະສານຄູ່ມື
example: Swagger generates interactive API documentation automatically from schema.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Swagger generates interactive API documentation automatically from schema.

meaning: ເຄື່ອງມືອອກແບບ ແລະ ທົດສອບ
example: Developers test REST endpoints interactively via the Swagger UI interface.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Developers test REST endpoints interactively via the Swagger UI interface.

meaning: ລະບົບວັດແທກຂໍ້ມູນໄລຍະໄກ
example: Application telemetry tracks performance bottlenecks and user engagement.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Application telemetry tracks performance bottlenecks and user engagement.

meaning: ຄວາມສາມາດໃນການສັງເກດການລະບົບ
example: Observability combines metrics, traces, and logs for deep diagnostics.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Observability combines metrics, traces, and logs for deep diagnostics.

meaning: ການຕິດຕາມການເຮັດວຽກຂ້າມລະບົບ
example: Distributed tracing follows an API request as it hops across multiple microservices.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Distributed tracing follows an API request as it hops across multiple microservices.

meaning: ຕົວຮວບຮວມລັອກ
example: The log aggregator indexes millions of server error logs into Elasticsearch.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: The log aggregator indexes millions of server error logs into Elasticsearch.

meaning: ການກວດຈັບສິ່ງຜິດປົກກະຕິ
example: Machine learning anomaly detection flags sudden spikes in network traffic.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Machine learning anomaly detection flags sudden spikes in network traffic.

meaning: ລະບົບແຈ້ງເຕືອນໄພອັດຕະໂນມັດ
example: Configure PagerDuty alerting when error rates exceed two percent.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Configure PagerDuty alerting when error rates exceed two percent.

meaning: ການເຂົ້າເວນເຝົ້າລະວັງລະບົບ
example: Engineers take turns on-call to fix critical server outages 24/7.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Engineers take turns on-call to fix critical server outages 24/7.

meaning: ຄູ່ມືແກ້ໄຂບັນຫາລະບົບ
example: Follow the runbook step-by-step to restore failed database replicas.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Follow the runbook step-by-step to restore failed database replicas.

meaning: ການປະຊຸມຖອດບົດຮຽນຫຼັງເກີດບັນຫາ
example: Blameless post-mortem meetings identify root causes and prevent future incidents.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Blameless post-mortem meetings identify root causes and prevent future incidents.

meaning: ການວິເຄາະຫາສາເຫດຕົ້ນຕໍ
example: Root cause analysis revealed a misconfigured DNS record caused the outage.
example_lao: ປະໂຫຍກຕົວຢ່າງ: Root cause analysis revealed a misconfigured DNS record caused the outage.

meaning: ການຕິດຕັ້ງອັດຕະໂນມັດໂດຍບໍ່ຕ້ອງແຕະຕ້ອງ
